summary: During a recent Senate hearing, experts advocated for the immediate implementation of AI regulations by Congress to protect consumers from the potential harms of the technology, such as algorithmic bias and the misuse of deepfakes. Concerns were raised about AI's impact on safety, privacy, economic, and national security, with comparisons drawn to the European Union's regulatory efforts and the White House's Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights. The discussion emphasized the need for transparency, accountability, and safeguards in AI development and deployment,

title: Federal Circuit Allows Apple’s Fintiv Challenge To Proceed
summary: The Federal Circuit Court of Appeals has revived Apple's challenge to the PTAB's Fintiv practice of discretionary denials, allowing it to proceed to the district court. This decision questions the USPTO's ability to issue rules through precedential decisions rather than traditional notice-and-comment rulemaking. The resolution of this case could significantly impact how the USPTO operates regarding Inter Partes Review practices.

title: Smart move: Artificial intelligence and 3D laser scanning for MEP applications
summary: This article explores how artificial intelligence (AI) and 3D laser scanning can significantly benefit Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) applications. It highlights how 3D laser scanning provides crucial accurate data for new construction or retrofitting projects, while AI can then process this data for pattern recognition, identifying optimal and energy-efficient solutions, and enhancing project management. The combination of these technologies, along with human expertise, is presented as a powerful tool for improving efficiency and decision-making in MEP design and implementation.

title: Netgear Nighthawk RS700 Router Brings Wi-Fi 7 and a Hefty Price Tag
summary: Netgear has announced the Nighthawk RS700, a new Wi-Fi 7 router priced at $699, which will be available in Q2 2023. This tri-band router supports Wi-Fi 7 features such as multi-link operation and preamble puncturing for reduced latency and increased data rates, alongside 10 Gbps WAN and LAN ports to accommodate emerging high-speed internet services. It also supports mesh operation and includes a year of Netgear Armor security.

title: Driverless trucks will deliver food to 3 Kroger stores in DFW area
summary: Kroger has partnered with Gatik to use driverless trucks for food deliveries to three stores in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. These 20-foot autonomous trucks will operate seven days a week from Kroger's Dallas distribution center, with the goal of improving online order fulfillment speed and efficiency. Initially, the trucks will include a safety driver for data collection, a practice that could last 19-25 months to ensure road safety.

title: Artificial Intelligence in China: Implications and Opportunities
summary: The rapid adoption of generative AI platforms like ChatGPT has highlighted China's strong position to benefit from the AI trend. Driven by massive data, a skilled workforce, supportive government policies, and an advanced manufacturing base, Chinese companies like Baidu, ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent are poised to become leaders in generative AI. The article details the foundational strengths of China's AI ecosystem and the potential beneficiaries within its tech and semiconductor industries.

title: China’s Answer to ChatGPT Gets an Artificial Debut and Disappoints (Published 2023)
summary: Baidu's debut of its ChatGPT rival, Ernie, disappointed investors after its "live" demonstration was revealed to be prerecorded, causing Baidu's shares to tumble. This event highlights China's ongoing efforts to catch up with the United States in AI development, particularly given restrictions on high-end computing chips. The botched rollout also points to the intensive global race in large language model technology, dominated by a few major players.

title: NICE Achieves Milestone of One Million Agents on CXone
summary: NICE has reached a significant milestone with one million agents and supervisors now using its CXone cloud platform, following its recognition by Gartner and integration of OpenAI's generative modeling. The company reported strong financial results for 2022, including a 10% increase in total revenue and 26% growth in cloud revenue, securing several eight-figure deals. NICE projects continued growth for 2023, leveraging its strong market position, cloud expansion, and AI advancements.

title: Here's how Chinese cyber spies exploited a critical Fortinet bug
summary: Mandiant security researchers have revealed that suspected Chinese spies exploited a critical Fortinet vulnerability (CVE-2022-41328) to steal credentials and maintain network access using custom malware. The group, UNC3886, also targeted VMware ESXi hypervisors in similar attacks last year. The sophisticated methods involved novel malware families like CASTLETAP and THINCRUST, and exploited the Fortinet bug via path traversal by uploading malicious files through a specific command.

title: eToro has launched a new investment portfolio
summary: eToro has expanded its smart investment portfolio offerings by launching the AI-Revolution portfolio, focusing on the artificial intelligence industry. This new portfolio divides companies into two groups: those involved in AI technology infrastructure and those across various sectors utilizing AI to enhance their products and services. A minimum investment of $500 is required for this portfolio.

title: Scientists at DeepMind and Meta Press Fusion of AI, Biology
summary: Scientists from DeepMind and Meta are pushing for a closer integration of AI and biology, citing recent breakthroughs in computational biology as evidence of its potential. Meta Platforms' new tool for predicting protein structures is presented as a continuation of advancements initiated by Alphabet's DeepMind, with experts anticipating that these AI systems will significantly accelerate progress in life sciences, especially in drug development.

title: Poly Studio X Family of Android-Based Video Bars are Now Certified for Google Meet
summary: HP announced that its Poly Studio X family of Android-based video bars are now certified for Google Meet, enabling organizations to leverage Poly's innovative room solutions. This certification guarantees compatibility and provides a seamless native experience with the Google Meet app built-in, simplifying setup and fostering efficient collaboration with advanced audio and video features like Poly DirectorAI and NoiseBlockAI. The Poly Studio X portfolio, including the X30, X50, and X70, offers solutions for various meeting space sizes, ensuring investment protection and continuous growth within the Google ecosystem.

title: Samsung unveils Exynos Modem 5300 to rival Qualcomm, MediaTek
summary: Samsung Electronics has officially unveiled its new Exynos Modem 5300, manufactured using advanced 4-nanometer EUV lithography, to compete with leading modem chipmakers like Qualcomm and MediaTek. The modem boasts download speeds up to 10 Gbps and upload speeds of 3.5 Gbps on 5G networks, with industry speculation pointing to its use in Google's upcoming Pixel 8 Series. This launch comes as Samsung aims to capture a larger share of the rapidly growing 5G modem market, which is projected to reach $10.8 billion by 2031.

title: Rackspace Lays Off 275 Employees As Stock Hits Bottom
summary: Rackspace Technology announced it is laying off 275 employees, approximately 4% of its global workforce, due to an uncertain economic climate and the need to align its cost structure with business demands. This decision comes as the company's stock has plummeted by 84% over the past year, trading at a near-all-time low of $1.76 per share, and after reporting an $805 million net loss in 2022 and experiencing a ransomware attack in December. Rackspace joins a growing list of tech companies implementing significant layoffs in 2023 amid a broader industry downturn.

title: Rackspace cutting workforce in response to downturn. Amid string of losses, its stock has plummeted.
summary: Rackspace Technology Inc. is laying off nearly 4 percent of its global workforce, approximately 275 employees, in response to a broad economic downturn. This decision comes as the company's stock has plummeted more than 80 percent in the last year, including a significant drop after a December ransomware attack. Rackspace is also struggling with a string of quarterly losses despite record revenues, and its CEO is implementing a new business strategy.

title: Understanding ChatGPT: The Promise and Nuances of Large Language Models
summary: The article explores ChatGPT, a Large Language Model (LLM) that has rapidly gained popularity, detailing its capabilities, underlying technology, and key limitations such as its inability to search the web or guarantee factual accuracy. It discusses potential business applications across various sectors while also highlighting associated risks and the importance of prompt engineering for optimal use.

title: Enterprise Connect 2023 Expo Hall: RingCentral, VMware, Five9, Cisco, More
summary: The Enterprise Connect 2023 conference showcased over 170 organizations at the Gaylord Palms Resort in Orlando, Florida. A major highlight was the significant advancement of artificial intelligence in UCaaS and CCaaS, with tech giants like Google Cloud, Microsoft, and Zoom unveiling new AI offerings. The article includes a slideshow featuring photos from the expo floor, highlighting the innovation and booth creativity of participating companies.

title: Is Google ending?
summary: This article explores whether Google's dominance in search and AI is coming to an end, citing challenges like failed product launches (Duplex), internal scandals, and a talent drain. The rise of competitors like OpenAI's ChatGPT and increased competition from Amazon and Apple in online search are highlighted as significant threats. Despite these setbacks, the article concludes that Google's vast resources, default search engine status, and strategic investments in AI mean it is still too early to write the company off.

title: DEFI Stock Price | Hashdex Bitcoin Futures ETF
summary: This article provides detailed financial information for the Hashdex Bitcoin Futures ETF (DEFI), including its current stock price, trading exchange (NYSE), and key statistics such as expense ratio and total assets. It also offers recent news and analysis related to Bitcoin and the broader market, along with technical analysis insights and the fund's profile. The DEFI ETF, launched in September 2022 by Hashdex Asset Management Ltd., invests in currency markets using derivatives like futures to track the Hashdex U.S. Bitcoin Futures Fund Benchmark.

title: McDonald's temporarily shuts US offices, prepares layoff notices: report
summary: McDonald's has temporarily closed its U.S. offices and instructed corporate staff to work from home as it prepares to announce layoffs. This move is part of a broader restructuring initiative, "Accelerating the Arches 2.0," aimed at improving efficiency and cutting costs. CEO Chris Kempczinski previously warned employees of "difficult discussions and decisions" regarding roles and staffing levels.

title: China AI: What Lies Ahead?
summary: A Citi Research report by Alicia Yap examines the AI landscape in China, forecasting significant growth in its generative AI application market from Rmb66.3bn in 2022 to Rmb207bn by 2025. The report also highlights the rapid expansion of China's cybersecurity market, projected to reach US$31.9bn by 2026, driven by digital economy demands and government support. It discusses how generative AI could revolutionize the SaaS industry and considers the impact of data privacy and censorship on China's AI progress.

title: Google Cloud brings new blood into its go-to-market organization
summary: Google Cloud is making significant changes to its go-to-market organization, bringing in new executive hires and rebranding its consultancy services to enhance sales efficiency. These changes follow the elevation of Adaire Fox-Martin as the top sales executive, indicating a strategic effort to strengthen Google Cloud's market position amidst slowing industry growth and increasing pressure for profitability. Industry analysts view these moves as a concerted effort to improve coverage, relevance, and access in the enterprise market, leveraging the new executives' deep experience.

title: Frontdoor App Changes the Game of Home Repair and Maintenance
summary: Frontdoor, Inc. has launched a new app that aims to revolutionize home repair and maintenance by connecting homeowners with pre-qualified experts via video chat. The app, available in mid-April, offers various features including DIY tips, maintenance reminders, and discounts. A new campaign from Fallon and Chemistry supports the launch, which also marks a reunion of brand and agency leaders.

title: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. stock rises Wednesday, outperforms market
summary: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. (SIRI) saw its stock rise by 3.13% on Wednesday, closing at $3.96. This performance outpaced the broader market, as the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.24% while the NASDAQ Composite Index fell 1.07%. The rise ended a two-day losing streak for the company, though its shares remain significantly below their 52-week high.

summary: This article provides live stock price, chart, and news for Green Visor Financial Technology Acquisition Corp. I (GVCI). It shows the current stock price, market capitalization, trading volume, and performance metrics. The company's stock trades on NASDAQ and currently has a bullish price prediction according to the site.

summary: This article provides live stock price, chart, and news for Flaherty & Crumrine Total Return Fund Inc. (FLC). It details current trading information, performance statistics, and fundamental data for FLC, which is trading on the NYSE. The article also includes a list of recent news headlines related to FLC from Seeking Alpha, highlighting past analysis and outlooks on the fund.

title: General Motors hates your iPhone
summary: General Motors has decided to remove CarPlay and Android Auto support from its future electric vehicles, opting instead for its own Android Automotive-based infotainment system. This decision, driven by GM's desire for increased control over data and subscription revenues, is criticized for prioritizing corporate interests over user convenience and potentially degrading the in-car experience. The article raises concerns about app compatibility, data syncing, and the long-term software quality in GM vehicles, questioning whether other automakers will follow suit or leverage CarPlay as a competitive advantage.

title: Qualcomm, Nvidia spar for top spot in AI chip efficiency tests
summary: Qualcomm's AI 100 chips outperformed Nvidia's H100 chips in two out of three power efficiency categories for AI inference tasks, specifically image classification and object detection. Nvidia, however, took the lead in natural language processing performance and power efficiency. This highlights the competitive landscape in the growing market for data center inference chips, where power consumption is a key cost factor.

title: Expedia CEO Looks to AI to ‘Rebalance’ Dependence on Google
summary: Expedia Group CEO Peter Kern believes that generative AI and other emerging technologies could help rebalance the travel advertising market, reducing reliance on Google. Kern and Chairman Barry Diller have long criticized Google's dominance in the sector, and they see AI as a potential way to diversify dependencies among big tech players. This shift could lead to a less centralized online travel ecosystem.

title: Billionaire Barry Diller says the media should 'absolutely' sue AI makers over ingesting text from articles
summary: Billionaire Barry Diller, chairman of IAC, urged media publishers to sue AI makers for using their content without compensation. He warned that generative AI tools like ChatGPT could "cannibalize" published works, drawing parallels to the early days of the internet when content was freely used. Diller emphasized that companies have legal grounds to sue under copyright law and should actively pursue litigation to ensure payment for the use of their intellectual property by AI.

title: Undervalued Communication Services Stocks
summary: This article identifies undervalued communication services stocks, highlighting names like Comcast, Disney, and Alphabet, which are trading at discounts after a challenging 2022. It screens for companies within the Morningstar US Communication Services Index that have a 4 or 5-star Morningstar Rating and a wide economic moat, providing analyst insights for the top five. The communication services sector saw a significant rebound in early 2023 after substantial losses in the previous year.

title: Amazon Launches AI Platform Aimed At Corporate Customers—Joining Google And Microsoft In AI Race
summary: Amazon has launched a new generative AI service called Bedrock, targeting corporate customers through its Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud platform. This move distinguishes Amazon from competitors like Microsoft and Google, which have focused more on consumer-facing AI products. Bedrock offers tools for businesses to build and scale their own AI applications, including Amazon's Titan large language models and integrations with other AI startups, aiming to democratize AI development securely and efficiently for enterprises.

title: Bloomberg plans to integrate GPT-style A.I. into its terminal
summary: Bloomberg LP is developing its own AI model, Bloomberg GPT, similar to OpenAI's GPT, specifically trained on financial data. This AI will be integrated into Bloomberg's terminal software to automate financial tasks, such as answering company-specific questions, assessing market sentiment from headlines, and generating financial headlines. The initiative highlights a trend of specialized AI development beyond general models, leveraging proprietary financial datasets to enhance accuracy for industry-specific applications.

title: 13 Top Earth Day Campaigns This Decade
summary: This article showcases 13 impactful Earth Day campaigns from the past decade that successfully blend brand messaging with environmental awareness. It highlights how companies like Lundberg Family Farms, Sony BBC Earth, Impossible Foods, and Mastercard have utilized creative strategies, from catchy slogans and video content to gamified sustainability and strategic partnerships, to engage consumers and promote eco-friendly initiatives. The piece emphasizes that sustainability is not only good for the planet but also a powerful tool for business, resonating with a growing number of environmentally conscious consumers.

title: Gartner Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence Platforms 2023
summary: This article summarizes the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence Platforms, categorizing vendors into Leaders, Challengers, Visionaries, and Niche Players. It details the strengths and cautions for each vendor based on Gartner's evaluation of their ABI platforms. The report highlights Microsoft, Salesforce, and Qlik as leaders, and notes movements of several companies since the 2022 report, particularly Pyramid Analytics' jump to visionary status.

title: Tap collaboration devices for employee experience data
summary: This article explores how collaboration devices can significantly enhance employee experience. It details four key strategies: leveraging device data to understand employee behavior and engagement, simplifying the process of starting in-room meetings with one-click-to-join systems, ensuring equity between in-office and remote participants through advanced camera setups and touchscreens, and encouraging the use of wellness features embedded in communication software. The piece emphasizes the importance of analyzing collected data and taking action to improve productivity and engagement based on these insights.

title: Google DeepMind: Bringing together two world-class AI teams
summary: Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai announced the formation of Google DeepMind, merging Google Research's Brain team and DeepMind. This new unit aims to accelerate progress in AI development, focusing on building more capable, safe, and responsible general AI systems. Demis Hassabis will lead Google DeepMind as CEO, while Jeff Dean will take on the elevated role of Google's Chief Scientist, focusing on future AI research and multimodal AI models.

title: Better Bear-Market Buy: Unity Technologies Stock or Digital Turbine Stock?
summary: This article compares Unity Technologies (U) and Digital Turbine (APPS) as potential bear-market buys, noting both have seen significant stock drops. It highlights their direct competition in the mobile app discovery market, particularly after Unity's merger with ironSource, and ultimately suggests Unity may be the better buy due to its "end-to-end platform" approach.

title: Google CEO Sundar Pichai receives third $200 million-plus stock award
summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai has received his third stock award exceeding $200 million, as disclosed by Alphabet Inc. The $218 million award, made public in an SEC filing, follows a similar pattern of triennial bonuses that align his compensation with long-term shareholder value and Alphabet's stock performance. This award vests over three years and includes both time-based and performance-based components.

title: B+C Hall of Fame 2023: Matt Bond
summary: Matt Bond, Chairman of Content Distribution at NBCUniversal, is honored by the B+C Hall of Fame for his influential career in cable programming and distribution. Known as a tough negotiator from his time at TCI and Comcast to his current role at NBCU, Bond has been involved in numerous significant transactions. The article also highlights his remarkable recovery from a severe heart attack and his philosophical view of his career journey from the "Model T era" to the "Tesla era" of television.

title: Google Workspace Extends Enterprise-Grade Security and Device Management for Hybrid Work with Okta and VMware
summary: Google Cloud announced new security alliances with Okta and VMware to enhance enterprise-grade security and device management for Google Workspace, supporting hybrid work environments. These partnerships extend Google Workspace's built-in capabilities, offering large organizations more choice and flexibility in identity, access, and device management. Additionally, JumpCloud integrates with Google Workspace to provide small and midsize organizations with modern, cloud-based directory services as an alternative to legacy solutions.

title: Google (GOOGL) announces plan for additional $70 billion share buyback
summary: Alphabet, Google's parent company, has announced authorization for an additional $70 billion share buyback, nearly a year after a similar $70 billion buyback. This decision follows its Q1 2023 earnings report, where the company beat EPS and revenue expectations. The buyback aims to return capital to shareholders, with shares expected to be repurchased through various market transactions.

title: 3 reasons why the Vanguard MSCI Index International Shares ETF (VGS) could be an excellent investment for beginners
summary: The Vanguard MSCI Index International Shares ETF (VGS) is presented as an excellent investment option for beginners due to its significant diversification across major developed markets and sectors, its strong long-term performance, and its low management fees. The ETF offers exposure to over 1,400 businesses globally, including tech giants, and has historically delivered solid returns while keeping costs down.

title: 3M laying off 10 percent of workforce amid slowing demand
summary: 3M announced it will cut 6,000 jobs, in addition to 2,500 previously announced, reducing its workforce by approximately 10 percent due to slowing global demand for goods. CEO Mike Roman stated the layoffs will span all functions, businesses, and geographies, aimed at reducing costs by up to $900 million annually. The decision reflects a shift in consumer spending from goods to services post-pandemic and broader economic slowdown.

title: Accenture is cutting 75 San Jose workers
summary: Accenture is cutting 75 employees based at Google's campus in North San Jose, appearing to be cutting contractors who worked for Google. This news comes amidst a wave of other major layoffs by tech companies including First Republic, Google, Lyft, and Meta Platforms.

title: Elon Musk Threatens to Sue Microsoft Over Alleged Illegal Data Usage
summary: Elon Musk is threatening to sue Microsoft, alleging unauthorized use of Twitter's data for training its AI models. This comes after Microsoft stopped supporting Twitter on one of its advertising platforms due to Musk's high asking price for API access. Musk claims Microsoft "trained illegally using Twitter data" and sees this as an opportune moment for legal action, especially given Microsoft's $10 billion investment in OpenAI and the integration of GPT-4 into Bing.

title: Google Search vs. ChatGPT AI: Which Should P/C Insurers Use?
summary: Travelers' technology and data science leaders suggest that P/C insurers should use both Google Search and ChatGPT for optimal results. While Google is better for current information and fact-checking, ChatGPT can also be a valuable tool. The article highlights that using a combination of both AI tools is the best approach for gaining comprehensive insights.

title: U.S. government has 'serious concerns' that some H-1B visa applicants are trying to game the system
summary: The U.S. government has expressed "serious concerns" that some H-1B visa applicants are manipulating the lottery system, as application numbers soared by 61% this year. Authorities suspect some applicants are submitting multiple bids through different company names without genuine job offers to gain an unfair advantage. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services is conducting fraud investigations and referring some cases to federal prosecutors, noting a significant increase in registrations tied to multiple applications for the same individual.

title: Monument class action alleges telehealth platform shared personal health info with third parties
summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Monument Inc., an online alcohol counseling and treatment company, alleging it shared patients' private health and identifiable information with third parties like Meta and Google without consent. The lawsuit claims Monument used a tracking pixel to transmit data including names, birthdates, and IP addresses, and that the company acknowledged disclosing information of over 108,000 individuals. The plaintiff seeks to represent a nationwide class and a Florida subclass, demanding a jury trial, injunctive relief, and damages.

title: Survey Signals Pause-and-Pivot Year for CEOs
summary: The 2023 Gartner CEO and Senior Business Executive Survey indicates a shift from short-term reactivity to cautious long-term planning, with CEOs focusing on business productivity and new three- to seven-year growth strategies. While growth remains a top priority, profitability is investors' primary concern, leading to an emphasis on multiyear productivity engineering and the creative application of new technologies like AI and automation. Talent and workforce issues, including shortages and compensation demands, continue to be significant challenges for executives.

title: Nextdoor Is Integrating Generative AI to Drive Engaging and Kind Conversations in the Neighborhood
summary: Nextdoor announced the integration of generative AI technologies, developed with OpenAI and leveraging the ChatGPT API, to foster more positive and engaging community interactions in the U.S. These new features will assist neighbors in writing posts that drive positive engagement and will suggest kinder revisions for potentially unkind comments. Nextdoor aims to personalize content and strengthen communities through these AI applications, led by Head of AI Qi He.

title: 5 Amazing Ways Meta (Facebook) Is Using Generative AI
summary: Meta, the parent company of Facebook, is heavily investing in generative AI despite its initial focus on the metaverse. The company is implementing generative AI across various platforms to enhance advertising, power AI-driven chat functionalities, revolutionize image and natural language generation, and ultimately, simplify content creation within its metaverse platform, Horizons. These initiatives aim to make content creation more accessible and potentially increase user engagement with Meta's virtual world.

title: Msci Kld 400 Social Index: Meaning, Example, FAQs
summary: The MSCI KLD 400 Social Index is a market capitalization-weighted stock index that focuses on large, mid, and small-cap U.S. companies with high environmental, social, and governance (ESG) standards, excluding certain industries. Founded as the Domini 400 Social Index, it was a pioneer in socially responsible investing. The index is reviewed quarterly and tends to be dominated by large American technology companies like Microsoft, NVIDIA, Alphabet, Tesla, and Visa.

title: CII Opposes Admitting Dual-Class Stock to S&P Indexes
summary: The Council of Institutional Investors (CII) has expressed "surprise and disappointment" over S&P Dow Jones Indices' decision to reverse its 2017 ban on admitting new dual-class stock companies to its indexes. This policy change, which allows companies like Blackstone into the S&P 500 despite having unequal voting rights, is criticized by CII for its opaque rationale and lack of investor consultation. S&P defends the change by citing the proliferation of dual-class structures, especially in tech, and the inconsistency of its previous grandfathering policy.

title: Is the Market Reacting Too Negatively to Pinterest Earnings?
summary: Pinterest's stock tumbled 25% despite beating Q1 2023 top and bottom-line estimates and growing monthly active users (MAUs). The sell-off was primarily driven by concerns over slowing growth, rising operating expenses (opex), and a GAAP net loss of $209 million due to restructuring charges. While analysts remain cautiously optimistic with reiterations, several lowered price targets, reflecting market uncertainty regarding the company's profitability amidst its strategic restructuring efforts.

title: Google’s Quantum Computing Technology in 2024 Review
summary: This article reviews Google's quantum computing technology in 2024, tracing its journey from the Quantum AI Lab's launch in 2013 to its achievement of "quantum supremacy" in 2019. It details Google's core quantum technologies, offerings like QVM and Cirq, and its efforts in post-quantum cryptography. The piece also outlines Google's main competitors, funding sources, significant customers, and strategic partnerships, while acknowledging challenges such as the refined classical algorithms that have narrowed the 'quantum supremacy' gap.

title: WSJ News Exclusive | Wendy’s, Google Train Next-Generation Order Taker: an AI Chatbot
summary: Wendy's is partnering with Google to automate its drive-through service using an AI chatbot. This chatbot is powered by Google's natural-language software and has been trained to understand various menu items and ordering styles, including specific Wendy's terminology like 'JBC' and 'biggie bags'. The initiative positions Wendy's among companies adopting generative AI for business growth.

title: Google AI pioneer says he quit to speak freely about technology's 'dangers'
summary: Geoffrey Hinton, an artificial intelligence pioneer, resigned from Google to openly discuss the potential "dangers" of AI, which he now believes could become smarter than humans much sooner than initially anticipated. He expressed concerns about AI's ability to create convincing fake content, displace workers, and be misused by malicious actors, urging policymakers to regulate the technology. Hinton clarified that Google acted responsibly and his departure was not to criticize his former employer.

title: Near Columbus, Wendy's tests an AI-powered chatbot for drive-thru orders
summary: Wendy's is piloting an AI-powered chatbot near Columbus to take drive-thru orders, aiming to improve customer service and address labor shortages. The system, developed with Google Cloud's AI software, is designed to understand natural speech and improve order accuracy, a key focus for the company. This move reflects a broader trend among fast-food chains to integrate AI and automation for enhanced efficiency and customer satisfaction.

title: Barry Diller joins News Corp and Axel Springer to fight ‘destructive’ AI
summary: Billionaire Barry Diller, chairman of IAC and Expedia, is collaborating with News Corp and Axel Springer to combat the perceived threat of generative AI to news publishers. Diller warns that AI, particularly platforms like ChatGPT, poses a "destructive" risk similar to the early internet's impact on journalism, advocating for redefined copyright laws and direct compensation for publishers whose content is used to train AI models. He also commented on Rupert Murdoch's legacy, stating the Dominion case stained his reputation.

title: Here's how AI is driving the rise of GPU cloud specialists
summary: The rise of AI is fueling a new class of cloud providers specializing in GPU compute, offering lower prices than generalized cloud competitors. Companies like CoreWeave, Lambda Labs, RunPod, and Arc Compute are catering to AI workloads that require substantial GPU resources. These niche providers differentiate themselves through competitive pricing, strategic locations, and ready access to scarce compute resources amidst supply chain challenges.

title: Launch of first TiVo-based TVs delayed to second half of 2023
summary: The launch of the first TiVo-based connected TVs, manufactured by Vestel, has been delayed from spring to the second half of 2023, aligning with the holiday buying season. Despite this delay, Xperi, TiVo's parent company, maintains its revenue guidance for the year and announced a second "top 10" connected TV OEM partner for the European market, with product shipments expected in 2024. Xperi aims to expand this into a global business, emphasizing an independent, unbiased media platform in the competitive smart TV market.

title: Comparing Google’s Bard with ChatGPT: What’s wrong, what’s bright
summary: This article provides a critical comparison between Google's Bard and OpenAI's ChatGPT, highlighting Bard's shortcomings despite Google's vast data resources. The author, Satyen K. Bordoloi, describes issues with Bard's memory, translation capabilities, and tendency to "hallucinate" incorrect information, contrasting it with ChatGPT's more coherent, though sometimes less creative, outputs. The piece argues that while Google has the potential to create a superior AI, Bard still requires significant development to live up to expectations.

title: Roundhill Launches Generative AI & Technology ETF With CHAT
summary: Roundhill Investments has launched the Roundhill Generative AI & Technology ETF (CHAT), an actively managed ETF focusing on global companies leading in generative AI technology. The fund aims to offer precise exposure to generative AI, distinguishing itself from other AI-themed ETFs that may lack such specific focus. Top holdings include Nvidia, Microsoft, and Alphabet, with expectations for the basket to expand as more companies genuinely contribute to the generative AI space.

title: Comscore Selected as Preferred Partner for NBCUniversal’s Local Advertising Currency
summary: Comscore announced a historic partnership with NBCUniversal, where NBCUniversal will guarantee all local ad buys on Comscore measurement. This expanded partnership will support transactional currency for local advertisers across NBCUniversal's 31 local markets and 42 owned stations. The move signifies a major shift in local market measurement, leveraging Comscore's near census-level data and 48-hour post air-date reporting.

title: Roundhill Investments Launches Generative AI & Technology ETF (NYSE Arca: CHAT)
summary: Roundhill Investments has launched the Roundhill Generative AI & Technology ETF (NYSE Arca: CHAT), providing investors with exposure to companies at the forefront of generative AI technology. The ETF aims to capitalize on the rapidly growing generative AI market, which Roundhill estimates to have a total addressable market of over $120 billion for enterprise software. CHAT is an actively-managed ETF with top holdings including Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Salesforce, offering investors a way to participate in this innovative and transformative technology.

title: What you need to know about Temu, the online shopping app dominating download charts
summary: Online shopping app Temu, owned by Chinese company PDD Holdings Inc., has quickly risen to popularity in Canada with its aggressive marketing, low prices, and gamified shopping experience. While it offers bargain deals, experts caution consumers about product quality, potential environmental impact from shipping and returns, and data privacy concerns given its sister app's issues. The platform's "growth-at-all-costs" approach and referral schemes are disrupting the e-commerce market, leading to a "race to the bottom" that could hurt local businesses.

title: University of Chicago Gets Quantum Tech Funding From IBM, Google
summary: The University of Chicago has secured up to $150 million in funding from IBM and Google to accelerate the development of quantum computing. IBM plans to collaborate with the university and the University of Tokyo over ten years to build a quantum-centric supercomputer, a project valued at $100 million. This partnership aims to advance the field of quantum technology, which promises faster computing and enhanced online security.

title: ChatGPT plugins' potential impact on the travel booking experience
summary: The article discusses the potential of ChatGPT plugins to revolutionize the travel booking experience by providing real-time data for transactional purposes, a significant advancement over previous AI chatbot limitations. It highlights how these plugins can transform travel inspiration, planning, and search, moving towards more personalized and conversational interactions. The author suggests that travel companies should embrace this AI wave early to adapt to the evolving digital landscape, comparing the potential impact to that of the iOS App Store.

title: Fidelity Metaverse ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NASDAQ:FMET)
summary: This article provides an overview of the Fidelity Metaverse ETF (FMET), including its price, holdings, and recent news. FMET tracks a market cap-weighted index of equities related to the metaverse, launched on April 19, 2022, and is managed by Fidelity. The ETF has seen a significant increase in share price since the beginning of 2025 and lists its top institutional shareholders and key holdings.

title: Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NASDAQ:HLAL) $HLAL
summary: The Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF (HLAL) tracks the FTSE USA Shariah index, focusing on Sharia-compliant US equities. The ETF, launched in 2019 and managed by Wahed, had a market capitalization of $736.85 million and assets under management of $758.04 million at the time of the article. Its top holdings include major tech companies like Apple, Microsoft, and Alphabet, and it recently declared quarterly distributions.

title: 강남 부자들이 줄섰다는데…年19% 배당에 차익 노리는 이 상품은
summary: 서학개미들이 최근 미국 증시에서 장기채 ETF, 특히 ‘아이셰어스 만기 20년 이상 국채 바이라이트(TLTW)’를 집중 매집하고 있다. 이는 채권 금리 횡보 전망에 따라 매매 차익보다는 연 19%에 달하는 고배당 수익을 노린 투자 전략으로 분석된다. TLTW는 월 지급 배당 상품으로, 현재 금리 변동성이 큰 시기에 투자자들에게 매력적인 상품으로 부상하고 있다.

title: ETF of the Week: Goldman Sachs Hedge Industry VIP ETF (GVIP)
summary: VettaFi’s Tom Lydon discusses the Goldman Sachs Hedge Industry VIP ETF (GVIP) which offers exposure to top holdings favored by hedge funds without an overweight toward any single stock. GVIP provides diversification across various companies, including some mid-cap and international stocks, making it a less volatile option for investors seeking innovative companies. It provides a consensus of top companies chosen by leading hedge fund managers, appealing to investors looking for strong, well-vetted companies.

title: ETF of the Week: Goldman Sachs Hedge Industry VIP ETF (GVIP)
summary: The Goldman Sachs Hedge Industry VIP ETF (GVIP) is highlighted as the ETF of the Week. GVIP provides exposure to top stock picks from hedge funds, focusing on a consensus of leading managers rather than an overweighting of individual stocks. The ETF diversifies holdings across large-cap, mid-cap, and international companies, offering a less volatile way for investors to participate in innovative companies.

title: Google announces US-Taiwan-Philippines cable with Chunghwa, Globe, and AT&T
summary: Google has announced plans for a new subsea cable system, TPU (Taiwan-Philippines-US), linking the US, Taiwan, and the Philippines, partnering with Chunghwa Telecom, Innove (Globe Group), and AT&T. This new cable, expected to be ready for service in 2025 with NEC as the supplier, will provide 260Tbps of capacity and offer an alternative route to Google's existing Apricot cable, enhancing resilience and capacity in the APAC region. Additionally, the article notes another subsea cable development, the EMC West system in the Middle East, being built by Center3 and ASN.

title: NVIDIA Announces DGX GH200 AI Supercomputer
summary: NVIDIA has unveiled the DGX GH200 AI supercomputer, designed to handle massive models for generative AI, recommender systems, and data analytics. This new system connects 256 Grace Hopper Superchips to function as a single 1-exaflop, 144TB GPU, offering significantly more memory than its predecessor. Companies like Google Cloud, Meta, and Microsoft are among the first to explore its capabilities, and NVIDIA is also building its own Helios supercomputer based on this design.

title: Google Pay
summary: This article from Barclays Private Bank details how to use Google Pay with Barclays debit cards, highlighting its security, convenience, and functionality for in-store and online payments. It provides step-by-step instructions for adding cards, answers frequently asked questions about eligibility, device compatibility, transaction limits, and what to do if a device is lost or stolen. Contact information for various client types is also included for support.

title: U.S. Supreme Court declines to hear bid to sue Reddit over child porn
summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has declined to hear a lawsuit attempting to hold Reddit Inc. liable for child pornography posted on its platform, upholding a lower court's decision that Reddit is shielded by Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act. The case explored the scope of a 2018 amendment, the Fight Online Sex Trafficking Act (FOSTA), which allows lawsuits if the claim involves child sex trafficking, but the court found Reddit did not "knowingly benefit" from such activity. This decision follows a similar sidestepping of Section 230 immunity in a separate case involving Google and YouTube.

title: Everything you need to know about Salesforce’s Q1 2024 financial results
summary: Salesforce, Inc. reported increased first-quarter adjusted earnings in Q1 2024 ($1.69 per share) and revenue growth of 11% year-over-year to $8.25 billion. All key operating segments showed growth, driven by its generative AI ecosystem including Einstein GPT, Slack GPT, and Tableau GPT. CEO Marc Benioff highlighted the role of the Salesforce GPT Trust Layer in securing customer data and enhancing enterprise automation.

title: Google head of communications and advisor to CEO Sundar Pichai to exit
summary: Corey duBrowa, Google's head of communications and a key advisor to CEO Sundar Pichai, is leaving the company after five years. He will be taking on the role of chief executive officer at BCW Global, a public relations firm based in New York.

title: Baidu Creates $140 Million Fund to Back ChatGPT-Like Startups
summary: Baidu Inc. has launched a 1 billion yuan ($140 million) fund to support Chinese startups developing generative AI, similar to ChatGPT services. This initiative aims to incubate projects built on Baidu's Ernie AI model, with individual deployments potentially reaching 10 million yuan. Venture capitalists like IDG Capital will assist in evaluating pitches and providing seed funding to promising founders.

title: Apple Bets On The Emerging Markets Growth Story
summary: Apple is increasingly focusing on emerging markets, particularly India, to drive growth amidst a challenging global smartphone market. The company achieved marginal growth in iPhone sales despite overall industry decline, with India seeing significant retail and manufacturing expansion plans. While services and financial technology offer long-term opportunities, the emerging markets strategy is a key component of Apple's immediate growth narrative, alongside ongoing share repurchases and dividend increases.

title: Vimeo is tuning out its streaming TV apps
summary: Vimeo is discontinuing its dedicated streaming TV apps for Apple TV, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, and Roku starting June 27th. Users can still watch Vimeo content on their TVs by casting from the Vimeo mobile app via Apple AirPlay 2 or Google Chromecast. This move aligns with Vimeo's strategic shift in recent years from a consumer-facing streaming destination to focusing on video-streaming services for businesses.

title: Microsoft Inks Deal With NVIDIA-Backed CoreWeave
summary: Microsoft has signed a deal with NVIDIA-backed cloud-computing startup CoreWeave, planning to invest billions to bolster its cloud computing infrastructure for AI operations. This partnership will provide Microsoft easier access to NVIDIA’s GPUs, which are crucial for AI-based applications like ChatGPT, and aims to give Microsoft a competitive edge against rivals like Alphabet Inc. and Amazon Web Services. CoreWeave’s access to over 45,000 GPUs and its status as an elite CSP in the NVIDIA Partner Network positions it as a key enabler for Microsoft's AI endeavors.

title: Rep. Zoe Lofgren weighs in on quantum plans
summary: Rep. Zoe Lofgren, ranking member of the House Science Committee, discussed her objectives for reauthorizing the National Quantum Initiative Act (NQIA). Her goals include incorporating NASA, increasing fundamental scientific investment, and focusing on commercialization, while emphasizing bipartisanship. Lofgren also commented on the funding of the CHIPS and Science Act and the feasibility of a new package given the current political climate.

title: Sonos Prevails Over Google in $32.5 Million Lawsuit Win
summary: A San Francisco federal jury has ordered Google to pay $32.5 million to Santa Barbara-based Sonos for infringing on one of its wireless audio device patents. This decision, made on May 26, is part of ongoing legal battles between the two companies, stemming from a 2020 lawsuit by Sonos alleging patent infringement by Google in its Home and Chromecast Audio products. While Sonos had initially sought up to $3 billion in damages, the final settlement was reduced to $32.5 million.

title: IT and Networking | Large Enterprise Solutions
summary: Lumen offers large enterprise IT and networking solutions designed to prepare businesses for the AI revolution, addressing the concerns of 86% of CIOs about network readiness. The platform provides secure, scalable, and high-performance connectivity, cybersecurity, and collaboration tools, leveraging a globally peered network and a programmable network fabric for AI workloads. Lumen also provides various infrastructure, connectivity, security, and communication services, featuring customer success stories and extensive resources for intelligent enterprise solutions.

title: TCL Takes Step Toward Its Own TVOS With Cineverse Deal For FAST Content and Streaming Tech
summary: TCL is moving to develop its own streaming operating system by partnering with Cineverse. This deal involves TCL licensing Cineverse's FAST channels and using Cineverse's Matchpoint SaaS streaming distribution platform for its phones and smart TVs in North America, marking a shift away from its previous reliance on Roku and Google TV. The Cineverse content and tech will first appear as a new streaming app on TCL TVs powered by Google TV, and later on TCL's Roku TVs.

title: Traders Could Use Google as an Alternate Play on AI
summary: Google is presented as an alternative investment for traders looking to capitalize on the growing artificial intelligence (AI) trend, given its increasing focus on AI capabilities beyond its search engine. The article discusses Direxion Investments' ETFs (GGLL and GGLS) for both bullish and bearish plays on Google, as well as the Direxion Daily Robotics, Artificial Intelligence & Automation Index Bull 2X ETF (UBOT) for a broader, leveraged AI investment.

title: A breakdown of AI ETFs as tech names burn bright
summary: This article breaks down various AI-focused ETFs available in Europe, examining their methodologies, holdings, and performance. It highlights the differences in how these ETFs define and capture the AI theme, from market-cap weighted exposure to companies involved in big data and NLP to equally-weighted exposure based on AI-related revenue or IP. The piece also compares their costs, liquidity, and correlation of returns, noting that while some are dominated by large tech names, others offer differentiated exposure to companies leveraging machine learning.

title: Additions to Fortinet FortiFlex deliver more flexible licensing options to customers
summary: Fortinet Inc. has introduced new product and service additions to its FortiFlex program, offering customers more flexible licensing options, including support for physical FortiGate next-generation firewall appliances. The program, which uses a points system for usage-based pricing, is now available via private offer in the Amazon Web Services Inc. Marketplace. FortiFlex aims to address the evolving needs of highly distributed networks by allowing organizations to pay by usage and manage licenses more efficiently across various deployment types.

title: Accenture looks to power AI efforts with $3 billion investment
summary: Accenture announced a significant $3 billion investment over three years into its data and AI practice, aiming to double the number of employees working with AI to 80,000. This move highlights a broader industry trend of companies scaling up generative AI offerings, following similar initiatives by Microsoft, Alphabet, and Salesforce. The investment also comes after recent layoffs at Accenture and includes the launch of an "AI Navigator for Enterprise" tool to guide businesses in AI adoption.

title: AMD launches new Instinct MI300X AI chip to take on Nvidia’s GPUs
summary: AMD has launched its new Instinct MI300X AI accelerator chip, designed to compete with Nvidia's GPUs in the generative AI market. The company also introduced its Infinity Architecture Platform, powered by eight MI300X chips, and its ROCm software ecosystem. Despite these announcements, AMD's stock fell due to a lack of major customer endorsements for the new chips and details on pricing.

title: AMD's AI chip challenge to Nvidia remains uphill fight with no big customers named
summary: AMD unveiled new details about its MI300X artificial intelligence chip, designed to challenge Nvidia's market dominance, but did not announce any major customers for the product. While the chip offers significant memory capacity aimed at cost reduction for AI services, the lack of customer commitments disappointed Wall Street, causing AMD's stock to fall. Analysts noted that Nvidia's strong market position is reinforced by its software ecosystem, which AMD is attempting to counter with its Rocm platform.

title: Someone is posing as a fake security company to create malicious GitHub repositories
summary: An unidentified actor is creating malicious GitHub repositories under the guise of a fake security company, High Sierra Cyber Security, offering exploits for popular products but delivering malware. These threat actors went to great lengths to establish fake personas and accounts, even using real security researchers' headshots. VulnCheck researchers, who uncovered this activity, warn that security researchers are valuable targets and advise caution when downloading code from GitHub, recommending vetting code thoroughly or running unknown exploits in isolated virtual machines.

title: Fidelity Metaverse ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (FMET)
summary: The Fidelity Metaverse ETF (FMET) has an aggregate rating of "Moderate Buy" with an average price target equal to its current share price of $36.66. The rating is based on 613 analyst ratings covering 20 companies (69.5% of the portfolio) over the past year. The ETF's top holdings include major tech companies like AMD, Alphabet, Apple, and NVIDIA.

title: EPAM Announces Strategic Global Partnership with Google Cloud
summary: EPAM Systems, Inc. announced a strategic global partnership with Google Cloud to develop and deploy AI-first solutions for enterprise digital transformation. This enhanced collaboration will leverage Google Cloud's AI and ML capabilities with EPAM's engineering expertise to deliver innovative cloud-enabled AI, data modernization, and analytics solutions across various industry verticals. The partnership aims to help clients accelerate their transformations into AI-enabled businesses and drive growth.

title: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman: 'It's time we grow up and behave like an adult company'
summary: In his first interview since a widespread subreddit blackout, Reddit CEO Steve Huffman defended the company's decision to charge third-party apps for data access, stating it's necessary for Reddit to be a sustainable business. He acknowledged the protest but maintained that the company would not reverse its plans, emphasizing that Reddit can no longer afford to give its valuable data away for free, especially with the rise of AI models leveraging it. Huffman views the move as an essential step for the 18-year-old company to mature and operate as an "adult company."

title: Trend Micro launches GPT-based cybersecurity assistant for the copiloted security operations center
summary: Trend Micro has released Companion, a new GPT 3.5-based generative AI assistant designed to enhance security operations centers (SOCs). Companion integrates with the Trend Vision One XDR platform, allowing SOC teams to ask threat hunting questions, explain alerts, automate incident reporting, and create mitigation recommendations. This move aims to improve the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of SOCs by reducing the manual workload on human analysts who are often overwhelmed by the volume of data and alerts.

title: Roundhill Ball Metaverse ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (METV)
summary: This article provides an aggregate rating and price target for the Roundhill Ball Metaverse ETF (METV) based on Wall Street analyst ratings of its holdings. METV has an aggregate rating of "Moderate Buy" and a price target of $16.79, derived from 595 analyst ratings covering 18 companies within its portfolio. The top holdings include tech giants like Apple, Roblox, NVIDIA, Alphabet, and Meta Platforms, along with their individual analyst ratings and potential upsides.

title: STF Tactical Growth ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (TUG) $TUG
summary: MarketBeat provides an aggregate rating and price target for the STF Tactical Growth ETF (TUG) by analyzing the ratings of its underlying holdings. The ETF currently holds a "Moderate Buy" aggregate rating with an aggregate price target of $38.63. The article details the top holdings of the ETF, including major tech companies like Apple, NVIDIA, and Microsoft, along with their individual analyst ratings, price targets, and potential upside.

title: Alger 35 ETF Review and Aggregate Rating (ATFV)
summary: The Alger 35 ETF (ATFV) has an aggregate rating of "Moderate Buy" based on 624 analyst ratings covering 24 companies, representing 89.7% of its portfolio. The ETF's aggregate price target is $33.33, with a range between $33.33 and $33.33. This rating is derived from a detailed assessment of its holdings by Wall Street analysts over the past year.

title: Sensex, Nifty Decline As RIL, ICICI Bank Drag: Market Wrap
summary: India's benchmark stock indices, Sensex and Nifty, declined on Monday despite opening higher, primarily dragged down by heavyweight stocks like ICICI Bank Ltd. and Reliance Industries Ltd. The S&P BSE Sensex fell by 216 points, and the NSE Nifty 50 closed 71 points lower. This decline mirrored a cautious global market sentiment following a strong second-quarter rally in Wall Street that lost momentum.

title: Comparing the Expense Ratios of ETFs Investing in AI: Which One Is Right for You?
summary: This article compares the expense ratios and year-to-date returns of four ETFs that invest in artificial intelligence, focusing on options with lower fees. It discusses broad-based tech ETFs like FTEC, IETC, and IYW, and a new economies composite ETF, KOMP, highlighting their investment strategies and top holdings. The piece advises investors to consider expense ratios, YTD returns, investment goals, risk tolerance, and portfolio diversification when choosing an AI-focused ETF.

title: HP Enterprise Offers Access to Cray Supercomputers for Building AI Models
summary: HP Enterprise is positioning itself as a key player in the AI revolution by offering access to its Cray supercomputers for building AI models. This move follows the trend of generative AI boosting other tech giants. HP Enterprise hopes to join the list of companies benefiting from the growing demand for AI development.

title: Intel pairs its hardware with HPE solutions to drive enterprise AI success
summary: Intel Corp. and Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. have partnered for 30 years and are now collaborating to deliver AI-focused solutions for enterprises. Intel's strategy involves powerful hardware like its GPU Max Series with 100 billion transistors and a comprehensive software suite called OpenVINO for training video-based AI use cases. This partnership aims to make advanced AI technology accessible to various sectors, including government, cloud companies, and general enterprises.

title: Some ESG Issues Take Center Stage at Big Tech Investor Meetings
summary: ESG principles are increasingly important at big tech companies, with shareholder demands evolving beyond traditional environmental concerns to focus on social and governance issues. Recent investor meetings at Alphabet and Meta, both holdings in the Invesco ESG Nasdaq 100 ETF (QQMG), saw a rise in shareholder resolutions concerning online safety, gender/racial equity, human rights, and executive compensation. This trend highlights the growing emphasis on the "S" and "G" in ESG, potentially positioning QQMG as a relevant investment for those seeking exposure to mega-cap growth with an ESG focus.

title: Amazon Is Spending $100 Million to Teach Cloud Customers About AI
summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is investing $100 million in a new Generative AI Innovation Center. This initiative aims to help its cloud customers develop and deploy AI products, connecting them with AI and machine learning experts. The move positions Amazon to compete with Microsoft and Google in the rapidly expanding generative AI market, with early users including Highspot, Twilio, Ryanair, and Lonely Planet.

title: Baidu: Why It’s One Of The Best Chinese Stocks To Own
summary: Baidu is presented as a strong opportunity among Chinese stocks despite current market underperformance. The article highlights its strengthening financials, particularly in ads and cloud, and its bullish innovation in AI with Ernie Bot and Apollo Go. Analyst upgrades and a significant price target increase by Morgan Stanley reinforce its potential for substantial upside.

title: Zoox headcount grows as Amazon's self-driving unit expands testing in Vegas
summary: Amazon's self-driving vehicle unit, Zoox, has increased its headcount by 16% to about 2,200 employees despite a challenging environment for autonomous driving companies. The unit is expanding testing of its driverless robotaxis on public roads in Las Vegas, preparing for a commercial launch. This expansion comes as other major players like Ford and Volkswagen have scaled back their autonomous driving ambitions.

title: AI Startup Typeface Raises $100 Million From Salesforce, GV
summary: Typeface Inc., an AI startup specializing in content creation services for businesses, has successfully raised $100 million in funding from investors including Salesforce Ventures and Alphabet’s GV. This investment values Typeface at $1 billion and increases its total fundraising to $165 million, reflecting growing investor interest in generative AI technologies.

title: Typeface lands $100M for its generative AI content creation engine
summary: Typeface Inc., a generative AI content creation platform, announced a $100 million Series B funding round, bringing its total raised to $165 million and valuing the company at $1 billion. The funding, led by Salesforce Ventures and other major VCs, will be used for sales and product development. Typeface's platform helps businesses automate and personalize content creation across various functions, including text and image generation, and has already secured partnerships with Salesforce and Google Cloud.

title: Apple’s market value ends above $3 trillion for the first time
summary: Apple Inc.'s market value surpassed $3 trillion for the first time at the close of a trading session, driven by positive inflation data and confidence in its market expansion strategies. This milestone reflects a 49 percent gain in Apple shares for 2023, amid a tech stock rebound fueled by expectations of slower interest rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and buzz around artificial intelligence. The company's financial resilience, strong balance sheet, and a recent augmented-reality headset launch contribute to its success, making it one of only five US companies with a valuation exceeding $1 trillion.

title: Oakmark Equity and Income Fund: Second Calendar Quarter 2023
summary: The Oakmark Equity and Income Fund gained 5.3% in Q2 2023, outperforming the Lipper Balanced Fund Index, despite market concentration in large-cap tech stocks. The fund adjusted its portfolio by reducing technology exposure and initiating new positions, primarily in the healthcare sector, based on a value-driven investment philosophy. The article also reflects on the foundational principles of diversification in portfolio construction, influenced by economist Harry Markowitz, and the fund's approach to asset allocation.

title: Q3 Stock Market Outlook: Time to Batten Down the Hatches or Raise the Sail?
summary: Morningstar's Q3 2023 stock market outlook suggests that while the U.S. market is still undervalued, the margin of safety has decreased, and the rally in the first half of the year has been disproportionately driven by a few "Magnificent Seven" stocks. Investors are advised to take profits from overextended growth and technology stocks and reallocate to undervalued sectors like communications and real estate, and to value, mid-cap, and small-cap stocks. The outlook anticipates slower market gains due to economic slowdown, tight monetary policy, and reduced credit availability, but expects any future pullbacks to be relatively shallow.

title: Apple makes history as first $3 trillion company amid tech stock surge
summary: Apple Inc. achieved a historic milestone, becoming the first company to reach a $3 trillion market value, driven by investor optimism about its expansion into new markets and a projected easing of interest rate hikes. This accomplishment is set against a backdrop of a broader tech stock surge, with other companies like Tesla and Nvidia also seeing significant gains due to advancements in AI and strategic partnerships. The article highlights Apple's strong financial performance and its reputation as a safe investment, alongside the success of other tech giants.

title: Cisco bats for universal AI regulation
summary: Cisco is advocating for universal AI regulation, emphasizing the need for a global public-private dialogue due to AI's far-reaching impact. The company believes AI should be used responsibly with transparency and collaboration between the public and private sectors to establish regulatory frameworks, including content attribution and copyright. This stance aligns with other tech giants like Microsoft and Google who also support AI regulation, and comes as the EU is actively pursuing legislation in this area.

title: Growth-Stock Funds Fly High but Fall Short in 2023′s First Half
summary: Growth-stock funds experienced a strong rebound in the first half of 2023 after significant losses in 2022, with large-growth funds doubling small-growth funds' gains. However, two-thirds of U.S.-centric active managers underperformed stylistically relevant indexes and passive rivals due to untimely sector allocations and light stakes in mega-cap stocks that drove market performance. International and emerging markets showed more modest gains, with some regions outperforming others, leading to a mixed bag for global stocks.

title: Why India Could Be the Next Big Destination for Global Investors
summary: India is rapidly emerging as a significant global economic player and an attractive destination for foreign investors, building stronger strategic and commercial ties with the U.S. Major global corporations are increasing their investments in the country, recognizing its flourishing economy driven by a growing middle class, favorable demographics, and policy reforms. Projections suggest India could become the world's second-largest economy by 2075, offering substantial opportunities despite existing challenges.

title: SaaS Paid Marketing Channels: Which Are Worth the Investment?
summary: This article explores eight effective paid marketing channels for SaaS businesses, including paid search, display advertising, product promotion on software comparison sites, social media advertising, influencer marketing, affiliate advertising, native advertising, and retargeted advertising. It provides pro tips for each channel and outlines three key considerations—goals, target audience, and budget—for determining the optimal paid marketing channel mix. The piece emphasizes the importance of diversifying paid media efforts to achieve higher revenue growth, as marketers utilizing more channels tend to outperform those using fewer.

title: Big tech firms turning focus on India: Jay Chaudhry, CEO, chairman and founder, Zscaler
summary: Jay Chaudhry, CEO, chairman, and founder of Zscaler, discusses the company's strong performance, commitment to innovation, and the critical role of Zero Trust Architecture in cybersecurity. He highlights India's significant contribution to Zscaler's R&D and growth, noting the increasing competition for talent in India as big tech firms shift their focus there. Chaudhry also shares his thoughts on the potential and misuse of AI technologies like ChatGPT and Bard.

title: Communication Services Stock Outlook: As Meta and Alphabet Soar, Traditional Telecom Comes Under Renewed Pressure
summary: This article discusses the contrasting performances within the communication services sector, highlighting the surge in Meta and Alphabet shares due to renewed online advertising demand and AI excitement. Conversely, traditional telecom companies like Verizon and AT&T face renewed pressure, though recent price increases and cost-cutting efforts are expected to improve their cash flow. The report also provides specific picks and fair value estimates for Disney, Verizon Communications, and Pinterest.

title: Kopin Corp is the Technology Seen Behind Smart AR Glasses
summary: Kopin Corp (NASDAQ: KOPN), a high-resolution microdisplay maker, is highlighted as a key technology provider for smart AR glasses, including supplying displays for Vuzix and Alphabet. Despite an 80% drop from 2021 highs, the company has made significant advancements, such as achieving 3 million nits brightness for its 2K x 2K MicroLED displays, essential for AR in bright conditions. Kopin's Q1 2023 results showed increased product revenues, especially in defense, and the new CEO emphasized renewed focus on quality and efficiency to improve margins and achieve cash flow breakdown by year-end.

title: Worldwide Public Cloud Services Revenues Surpass $500 Billion in 2022 -
summary: Worldwide public cloud services revenue reached $545.8 billion in 2022, a 22.9% increase from the previous year, with SaaS – Applications being the largest revenue source. Microsoft, Amazon Web Services, Salesforce Inc., Google, and Oracle remain the dominant providers, collectively capturing over 41% of the global revenue. IDC predicts continued growth in foundational cloud services, especially IaaS and PaaS, driven by digital transformation and AI integration.

title: Schneider Electric Partners with Intel and Applied Materials to Help Decarbonize the Semiconductor Value Chain with New Catalyze Program
summary: Schneider Electric has launched Catalyze, a new program in partnership with Intel and Applied Materials, aimed at accelerating the decarbonization of the global semiconductor value chain. This initiative seeks to increase the adoption of renewable energy among semiconductor suppliers by combining purchasing power and providing access to utility-scale Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs). The program will initially focus on specific markets where renewable energy is readily available, with plans for global expansion, encouraging thousands of suppliers to take action towards a low-carbon future.

title: First-of-its-Kind App, TheStreet Powered by Tornado, Launches One-Stop Investing Experience
summary: TheStreet and Tornado have launched a new app specifically designed to provide a comprehensive investing experience for all levels of investors. The app integrates TheStreet's news and investing ideas with Tornado's technology and community, offering tools like expert Q&A, tailored notifications, S&P Capital IQ data, and portfolio optimization. This collaboration aims to empower investors with knowledge and tools, expanding reach to a new audience.

title: Trading Analysis Tools - Analytics and Chart Tools
summary: FOREX.com offers a suite of trading analysis tools, including Performance Analytics powered by Chasing Returns to help traders refine their skills through behavioral science insights. The platform also provides advanced charts integrated with TradingView, offering extensive indicators, drawing tools, and customization options for technical traders. Additionally, users can access real-time market news from Reuters, expert market analysis, an economic calendar, and various alert features to keep track of market movements.

title: Indian-origin Indra Nooyi and Jayshree Ullal among America’s richest
summary: Four Indian-origin women, including Jayshree Ullal and Indra Nooyi, have been featured in Forbes' list of 'America’s Richest Self-Made Women,' with a combined net worth of USD 4.06 billion. Jayshree Ullal, President and CEO of Arista Networks, is ranked 15th with $2.4 billion, while Indra Nooyi, former PepsiCo CEO, is 77th with $350 million. Neerja Sethi and Neha Narkhede also made the list, reflecting significant achievements in technology and business.

title: SEC acknowledges bitcoin ETF filings from BlackRock, Bitwise and others
summary: The SEC has formally acknowledged spot bitcoin ETF applications from major asset managers including BlackRock and Bitwise. This move follows a surge of institutional filings, notably spurred by BlackRock's application in June, indicating a significant step forward in the regulatory review process for these financial products. The applications are now officially under review, with various firms looking to leverage this new investment opportunity.

title: Chinese e-commerce giant JD.com launches own large language model, ChatRhino
summary: Chinese e-commerce giant JD.com has launched its own large language model (LLM) called ChatRhino, aiming to integrate AI into various industrial applications. The company emphasizes that the value of LLMs will be realized through industrial use cases, with ChatRhino designed to offer targeted solutions across sectors like retail, logistics, finance, and healthcare by combining general data with intelligent supply chain data. This move reflects the broader Chinese tech industry's efforts to catch up with Western advancements in AI and aligns with the government's push to regulate LLMs.

title: Why the Nasdaq 100 may not capture the full growth potential of AI
summary: This article argues that while the Nasdaq-100 has seen significant gains from AI-driven tech stocks like Nvidia, it may not offer investors the most comprehensive or effective exposure to the long-term growth potential of artificial intelligence. The authors suggest that dedicated AI thematic strategies can provide broader diversification into pure-play AI companies, capture the growth of future mega-caps earlier, and improve risk-adjusted returns compared to a core allocation in the Nasdaq-100. They emphasize that while the Nasdaq-100 taps into AI through a few large companies, a targeted AI strategy offers more comprehensive exposure across the evolving AI landscape.

title: Caribbean phone companies suffering from “market failure” due to Over-The Top services, Social Media
summary: Caribbean telecommunication companies are experiencing "market failure" due to the prevalent use of Over-The-Top (OTT) services and social media, which consume the majority of data and international call traffic, leading to significant financial losses for local providers. Despite annual investments exceeding US$500 million in network upgrades since 2017, these companies face declining voice revenues and a lack of significant contribution from major tech companies that utilize their infrastructure. Industry leaders are advocating for government intervention and a unified CARICOM approach to address this imbalance and ensure a fair share from big tech, warning of dire consequences for regional connectivity and economic development if the issue remains unresolved.

title: Unstructured raises $25M for large language model data processing expansion
summary: Unstructured Technologies Inc. has secured $25 million in new funding to expand its operations for processing data for large language models. Founded by a former CIA analyst, the company provides a platform that converts unstructured internal data into LLM-compatible formats, addressing the challenge of scattered data for organizations. The funding round was led by Bain Capital Venture Associates LLC with participation from several other investors.

title: Nasdaq Is Reducing the Influence of Giant Tech Firms in a Popular Stock Market Index
summary: Nasdaq is implementing a "special rebalance" of its Nasdaq 100 index to reduce the dominance of giant tech firms like Apple and Microsoft. This move addresses the historic rally of a few mega-cap tech stocks, which have caused overconcentration in the index and potentially increased diversification risk for investors. The rebalance, effective July 24, will prompt funds tracking the index to adjust their portfolios, potentially leading to trading costs and minor market volatility.

title: TD Cowen: Record year expected as US data center leases hit 2.1GW in 90 days due to AI boom
summary: TD Cowen reports that the US data center market is poised for a record year, with 2.1GW of leases signed in the last 90 days, primarily driven by artificial intelligence demand. Hyperscalers like Google and Microsoft have secured massive deals, leading to a significant tightening of the leasing market and a shift towards pre-leasing capacity further in advance. This boom is expected to benefit companies like Equinix and Digital Realty, though supply chain issues with long lead times for equipment persist.

title: Barbenheimer and Redefining Movie Marketing Strategies
summary: The "Barbenheimer" phenomenon, involving the simultaneous release and unexpected mutual bolstering of "Barbie" and "Oppenheimer," significantly boosted the theatrical movie business. Both films achieved impressive box office numbers domestically, with "Barbie" leveraging social media, especially TikTok, to drive engagement and redefine marketing strategies. This success highlights the importance of tailored social media approaches and presents new opportunities for long-term growth and audience connection for brands.

title: Apple, Meta, Google argue they're not 'bookies' in casino app appeal
summary: Apple, Meta, and Google are appealing a 2022 ruling that found them potentially liable for facilitating purchases of virtual chips in casino game apps, arguing that this interpretation of Section 230 could jeopardize the entire internet economy. They contend that holding platforms liable for payment processing related to third-party content would force extensive monitoring and is a misinterpretation of existing legal precedents. The companies emphasize they act as publishers offering payment services, not creators of the allegedly illegal apps or chips, and that their conduct in these cases is distinct from prior rulings.

title: Google’s Co-Founder, Larry Page, gains $5 billion to his net worth
summary: Larry Page, co-founder of Alphabet Inc., has seen his net worth increase by $5.4 billion, reaching an impressive $109 billion and placing him 12th on Forbes' list of richest billionaires. This surge is primarily due to a 5.94% rise in Alphabet's share price following a strong second-quarter earnings report that surpassed analyst expectations. The company demonstrated exceptional performance in ad revenues for both Google and YouTube, and its Google Cloud business reported a profit for the second consecutive quarter.

title: Bond Performance in 2023: A Midsummer Reflection
summary: In mid-2023, year-to-date U.S. bond returns were positive but lagged significantly behind equity gains, and Treasurys showed negative after-inflation performance. While real bond yields appear attractive compared to historical averages, potential risks include persistent high inflation, increased U.S. debt issuance, and declining foreign demand for Treasurys. Despite these risks, opportunities may exist for bond investors, especially when considering their relative cheapness to equities.

title: YieldMax GOOGL Option Income Strategy ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:GOOY)
summary: This article provides detailed information on the YieldMax GOOGL Option Income Strategy ETF (GOOY), including its current price, dividend yield, expense ratio, and holdings. The ETF, launched on July 27, 2023, aims to generate income and capped gains from Alphabet Inc. stock through a synthetic covered call strategy. It also includes recent news headlines and frequently asked questions about the ETF's performance and investor details.

title: YieldMax Launches Synthetic Covered Call ETFs for Meta, Google
