title: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. – More market share gains expected
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is expected to gain further market share in the data center CPU market and capitalize on opportunities to expand its presence in the data center GPU market due to increased generative AI adoption. The company's margins are projected to grow post-acquisition of Xilinx and Pensando, driven by increasing revenue contributions from its Data Centre and Embedded segments. Phillip Securities Research initiates coverage with an Accumulate recommendation and a target price of US$125.00, anticipating marginal revenue growth in FY23e and re-acceleration in FY24e.

title: Semiconductor Stocks Are Hot -- So Is Their Long-Term Outlook
summary: Semiconductor stocks and related ETFs, like the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH), have experienced significant growth this year, driven largely by enthusiasm for artificial intelligence, particularly due to companies like Nvidia. While concerns about valuation exist, analysts believe the long-term outlook remains attractive, bolstered by a rebounding PC and smartphone market, and the massive potential of AI development across industries.

title: HIVE Rebrands, Announces Expansion Into Cloud Computing Services
summary: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd., formerly HIVE Blockchain, has rebranded and announced its expansion into cloud computing services, utilizing its 38,000 Nvidia GPUs. The company plans to launch "HIVE Cloud" to offer rental services for GPU server clusters, aiming to tap into the high demand for AI-driven computational power. While expanding into a potentially high-margin business, HIVE will also continue its existing bitcoin mining operations.

title: NVIDIA Drives Performance Gap Between AI Funds
summary: The article analyzes the performance gap between two major AI-focused ETFs, Global X Robotics & Artificial Intelligence ETF (BOTZ) and Global Robotics & Automation Index ETF (ROBO). It highlights how BOTZ's significant outperformance is largely attributed to its heavy weighting in NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA), which has seen exceptional growth. The comparison provides insights for investors considering different approaches to AI sector investments, acknowledging NVIDIA's dominance while also pointing out the risks associated with such a concentrated bet.

title: Fortinet’s stock nabs record closing high, while Microsoft, Nvidia, Broadcom bids all fall short
summary: On Friday, July 14, 2023, several AI-related stocks, including Microsoft, Nvidia, and Broadcom, aimed for record closing highs, but only Fortinet succeeded. Nvidia and Broadcom shares initially rose following positive analyst feedback on their AI chip market potential but ultimately closed down. This illustrates the fluctuating nature of the tech rally driven by artificial intelligence.

title: Nvidia’s stock could have a pathway to $600, Citi says
summary: Citi Research analyst Atif Malik has raised his price target for Nvidia Corp. stock to $520 from $420, citing the company's dominance in the rapidly growing artificial intelligence accelerator market. Malik also outlined a bull-case scenario where Nvidia's stock could reach $600. He anticipates blistering growth in the AI accelerator market, with Nvidia poised to outperform competitors.

title: A breakdown of the changes to the Nasdaq-100 and what it means for mega-cap tech stocks
summary: Nasdaq announced a special rebalance of the Nasdaq-100 Index to dilute the weightings of mega-cap tech stocks that have outperformed in 2023. The seven largest stocks in the Nasdaq-100 will see their combined weighting reduced from 56% to 44%, with Nvidia and Microsoft being most affected. Historically, similar rebalances have not had a significant impact on stock prices.

title: Preparing for Upcoming QQQ Changes
summary: Nasdaq is implementing a special rebalance of its Nasdaq-100 Index (NDX), impacting ETFs like Invesco QQQ (QQQ) and Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF (QQQM). This rebalance, effective July 24, aims to address concentration risk due to the large percentage holdings of tech giants like Microsoft and Apple. Investors can expect lower allocations to these mega-cap growth names, though the overall changes are not anticipated to be monumental, and the ETF structure should help avoid capital gains distributions for investors.

title: Why the Nasdaq 100 may not capture the full growth potential of AI
summary: This article argues that while the Nasdaq-100 has seen significant gains from AI-driven tech stocks like Nvidia, it may not offer investors the most comprehensive or effective exposure to the long-term growth potential of artificial intelligence. The authors suggest that dedicated AI thematic strategies can provide broader diversification into pure-play AI companies, capture the growth of future mega-caps earlier, and improve risk-adjusted returns compared to a core allocation in the Nasdaq-100. They emphasize that while the Nasdaq-100 taps into AI through a few large companies, a targeted AI strategy offers more comprehensive exposure across the evolving AI landscape.

title: Microsoft and Meta expand their AI partnership with Llama 2 on Azure and Windows
summary: Microsoft and Meta are expanding their AI partnership, bringing Meta's Llama 2 large language models to Azure and Windows. This collaboration aims to democratize AI by providing developers with open models, enabling them to build generative AI tools and experiences. Azure customers can now fine-tune and deploy Llama 2 models, while Windows developers can run Llama locally, integrating AI safety features from both companies.

title: Samsung primed for graphics chip leadership with GDDR7
summary: Samsung Electronics has unveiled the industry's first GDDR7 DRAM, which is faster and more energy-efficient than existing models. This new graphics memory product boasts a data transfer speed of 32 Gbps, making it able to process 50 ultra-high definition movies in one second, and consumes 20% less power than its predecessor. Samsung expects this technology to elevate user experiences in areas requiring outstanding graphics performance like AI, high-performance computing, and autonomous vehicles, positioning them to lead the graphics chip market.

title: Nasdaq Is Reducing the Influence of Giant Tech Firms in a Popular Stock Market Index
summary: Nasdaq is implementing a "special rebalance" of its Nasdaq 100 index to reduce the dominance of giant tech firms like Apple and Microsoft. This move addresses the historic rally of a few mega-cap tech stocks, which have caused overconcentration in the index and potentially increased diversification risk for investors. The rebalance, effective July 24, will prompt funds tracking the index to adjust their portfolios, potentially leading to trading costs and minor market volatility.

title: Startup Cerebras Takes on Nvidia With Chain of AI Supercomputers
summary: Cerebras Systems Inc. has launched the first of nine AI supercomputers, "Condor Galaxy 1," in partnership with Abu Dhabi's G42, aiming to challenge Nvidia's dominance in AI technology. The supercomputer, located in Santa Clara, California, is valued at over $100 million and will expand, with further systems planned for Austin, Asheville, and international locations. This initiative provides an alternative for AI workloads.

title: Applied Materials: Excessive AI Hype Drives Semiconductor Stock Overvaluation
summary: This article argues that the semiconductor industry, including Applied Materials (AMAT), is currently overvalued due to excessive AI hype, despite significant sales declines from major chipmakers. While AI will eventually benefit AMAT, the necessary capital investments may delay FCF boosts until the 2030s, and AI-related demand growth may be offset by falling demand in other sectors. The author believes AMAT's stock could lose over half its value as investors re-evaluate its immediate fundamentals.

title: Nvidia is ‘dominating’ and could unlock $300 billion in AI revenue by 2027, analyst says
summary: Mizuho analyst Vijay Rakesh is increasingly optimistic about Nvidia's prospects, projecting the company could tap into $300 billion in AI-related revenue by 2027. Rakesh believes Nvidia will maintain a significant share in the AI server market despite potential future competition. This outlook comes as Nvidia's stock has already seen a 200% increase this year.

title: KT invests over $11 mn in AI software company Moreh
summary: South Korea's KT Corp. is investing 15 billion won ($11.6 million) in Moreh, an AI infrastructure software company, marking its second investment since 2021. This strategic move aims to challenge Nvidia's dominance in AI services and strengthen KT's position as a full-stack AI operator, providing both hardware and software solutions. The investment supports KT's development of hyperscale AI Mi:dm and expansion of B2B AI services, reducing reliance on foreign GPU technologies.

title: NVIDIA Names Melissa Lora to Board of Directors
summary: NVIDIA announced the appointment of Melissa Lora, former president of Taco Bell International, to its board of directors and Audit Committee. CEO Jensen Huang highlighted her extensive senior management, operating experience, and finance expertise as immense benefits to the board. Lora's appointment expands NVIDIA's board to 14 members.

title: New YieldMax ETF Seeks Synthetic Covered Call Strategy on Amazon
summary: YieldMax has launched the YieldMax AMZN Option Income Strategy ETF (AMZY) on the NYSE, which utilizes a synthetic covered call strategy on Amazon (AMZN) to generate monthly income. This actively managed fund, advised by Tidal Financial Group and subadvised by ZEGA Financial, aims for compelling yields with capped participation in Amazon’s gains without directly investing in AMZN. AMZY follows a similar model to the previously launched YieldMax NVDA Option Income Strategy ETF (NVDY), offering investors enhanced income through options.

title: Micron Delivers Industry's Fastest, Highest-Capacity HBM to Advance Generative AI Innovation
summary: Micron Technology announced it has begun sampling the industry's first 8-high 24 GB HBM3 Gen2 memory, boasting bandwidth greater than 1.2 TB/s and pin speed over 9.2 Gb/s, a significant improvement over existing HBM3 solutions. This new memory offers a 2.5 times performance per watt improvement, setting new benchmarks for AI data center metrics and reducing training times for large language models like GPT-4. Micron's 12-high stack with 36 GB capacity is expected to sample in early 2024, further enhancing capacity and efficiency for generative AI and HPC applications.

title: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott: Generative AI Could Boost Global GDP By Almost $7 Trillion
summary: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott believes generative AI could boost global GDP by nearly $7 trillion, seeing it as a transformative moment comparable to the internet or iPhone. ServiceNow is integrating generative AI into all its workflow offerings and is partnering with Nvidia to accelerate customer value realization from AI. The company also reported strong second-quarter results, exceeding analyst expectations, driven by its role in digital transformation.

title: No Better Time Than Now to Work in Biotech, Amgen CEO Tells Summer Interns
summary: Amgen CEO Bob Bradway addressed the company's summer interns, emphasizing the exciting opportunities in biotechnology due to advancements in science, technology, and AI. He highlighted Amgen's mission of serving patients as its core strength and encouraged interns to make an impact, challenge the status quo, and leverage their unique talents in their careers. Interns praised Amgen's culture and leadership's commitment to mentorship and patient-centricity.

title: One in ten retail investors using Chat GPT-style AI to help pick and manage investments
summary: A study by eToro reveals that 11% of retail investors are currently using AI tools like ChatGPT for investment decisions, with this figure rising to 19% among 34-44-year-olds. An additional 35% are open to using AI, citing benefits like time savings and improved decision-making, while 40% remain against it. The findings also indicate strong retail investor confidence in the technology sector, with 30% planning to increase investment in tech for the rest of 2023, specifically highlighting AI.

title: Mutual Fund Top Trumps – TMT
summary: This article compares two TMT mutual funds, the BlackRock Next Generation Technology fund and the Janus Henderson Global Technology and Innovation fund, using the "Top Trumps" card game format. The comparison focuses on factors like 3-year performance, assets under management, alpha, volatility, ongoing charges, and information ratio. Ultimately, the Janus Henderson fund wins the comparison 4:2, and details on both funds' investment strategies, sector, and geographic breakdowns are provided.

title: UMC forecasts utilization rate to fall to 65%
summary: United Microelectronics Corp (UMC) anticipates its factory utilization rate will drop further to about 65% in the current quarter due to prolonged inventory correction and weak end-market demand. This represents the lowest utilization since Q4 2011, and the company finds it difficult to predict a bottom given customer inventory destocking through next quarter. Despite this, UMC plans to expand its 28-nanometer capacity and is doubling its silicon interposer wafer capacity to meet growing demand for AI chips.

title: U.S. chipmaker AMD to invest $400 million in India by 2028
summary: U.S. chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) announced a significant investment of $400 million in India over the next five years, including the establishment of its largest design center in Bengaluru, creating 3,000 new engineering jobs. This move aligns with India's efforts to become a chipmaking hub, attracting other major players like Applied Materials and Micron with its incentive programs. AMD's expansion underscores the country's growing importance in the global semiconductor industry.

title: Pixar, Apple and Nvidia are teaming up to promote a 3D file format that could help boost Apple's upcoming Vision Pro
summary: Pixar, Apple, Nvidia, Adobe, and Autodesk are collaborating to promote OpenUSD, a 3D file format. This initiative aims to streamline the creation of 3D content, potentially benefiting game development based on Pixar movies and boosting Apple's upcoming Vision Pro mixed-reality headset by making 3D environments more accessible.

title: Hesai Technology Advances Autonomous Vehicle Lidar Integration with NVIDIA DRIVE and Omniverse
summary: Hesai Technology has announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to integrate its lidar sensors into the NVIDIA DRIVE and NVIDIA Omniverse ecosystems. This partnership aims to enhance autonomous driving development by providing developers with tools to seamlessly integrate Hesai's lidar sensors, such as the AT128, into their systems and utilize NVIDIA's simulation platforms for robust testing. The collaboration is expected to accelerate the deployment of safe and efficient autonomous driving solutions.

title: Beating the benchmark? How AI-driven ETFs stack up
summary: The article discusses the performance of AI-driven ETFs and whether they offer an information advantage in stock selection compared to traditional benchmarks. It highlights examples like the QRAFT AI-Enhanced U.S. Large Cap Momentum ETF (AMOM) and the AI Powered Equity ETF (AIEQ), noting AMOM's outperformance against a momentum benchmark while AIEQ trails the S&P 500. The piece also explores the potential benefits of AI in portfolio management, such as a lack of emotion and more frequent rebalancing.

title: Qualcomm's fiscal 3Q results fall short as slowing smartphone demand takes its toll
summary: Qualcomm's fiscal third-quarter results missed sales expectations and guidance due to softening smartphone demand, causing its stock to dip. The company, a major processor supplier for Android devices, reported adjusted earnings above Street expectations but significantly down year-over-year. CEO Cristiano Amon is banking on Qualcomm's artificial intelligence strategy to drive future growth.

title: CoreWeave Secures $2.3 Billion Debt Financing Facility led by Magnetar Capital and Blackstone to Meet Surging Demand and Ongoing Expansion of Specialized Cloud Infrastructure to Power AI
summary: CoreWeave has secured a $2.3 billion debt financing facility led by Magnetar Capital and Blackstone to fuel its expansion of specialized cloud infrastructure for AI. This funding will enable CoreWeave to purchase more compute resources, open new data centers, and grow its staff to meet the surging demand for large-scale GPU-accelerated workloads in the generative AI space. The company plans to have 14 data centers by the end of 2023 and recently unveiled the world's fastest AI supercomputer.

title: Gen Digital earnings beat, revenue was in line with estimates
summary: Gen Digital (NASDAQ: GEN) reported its first-quarter earnings, with an EPS of $0.47, surpassing analyst estimates of $0.46. The company's revenue for the quarter was $946 million, matching the consensus estimate. Gen Digital's stock has seen an 8.57% increase in the last three months, though it is down 30.00% over the last 12 months.

title: AMD's stock breaks with chip selloff to finish week higher as analyst cites 'important buying opportunity'
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares unexpectedly rose last week, up 2.6%, despite a broader chip sector selloff that saw Nvidia and the PHLX Semiconductor Index decline significantly. An analyst pointed to this performance as an "important buying opportunity" for AMD. Nvidia's earnings report is anticipated on August 23rd.

title: Micron Launches Memory Expansion Module Portfolio to Accelerate CXL 2.0 Adoption
summary: Micron Technology announced the sample availability of its CZ120 memory expansion modules, designed to accelerate CXL 2.0 adoption. These modules, available in 128 GB and 256 GB capacities, enhance server systems by providing incremental memory capacity and bandwidth, particularly beneficial for AI, SaaS, and HPC workloads. Micron is collaborating with Intel and AMD to validate the CZ120 modules on their CXL-compatible platforms.

title: AI as an investment theme
summary: The article discusses Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a significant investment theme due to its potential to revolutionize industries and create new opportunities. It highlights the booming AI sector, strong investor interest, and the impact of AI on technology stocks and the broader market. The author also touches upon various ways to invest in AI, including specific ETFs, and emphasizes the importance of careful research despite the vast potential.

title: Nvidia teams with Accenture and ServiceNow for AI program
summary: Nvidia, Accenture, and ServiceNow have partnered to launch "AI Lighthouse," a program aimed at helping ServiceNow customers quickly integrate generative AI tools. The initiative combines ServiceNow's automation platform, Nvidia's AI supercomputing and software resources, and Accenture's consulting expertise to develop and deploy custom generative AI large language models and applications. The program focuses on enhancing customer service, promoting self-service options, automating content generation, and boosting developer productivity.

title: 3 AI Stocks You’ll Regret Not Buying Soon
summary: This article highlights three AI stocks that show significant potential in the medical industry: Lantern Pharma (LTRN), Recursion Pharmaceuticals (RXRX), and AbCellera Biologics (ABCL). These companies are leveraging AI to accelerate drug discovery, improve treatment development, and form strategic partnerships, addressing the high costs and failure rates of traditional drug development. Investors are encouraged to consider these stocks due to their innovative approaches and recent positive developments.

title: The Case For Intel: An Illustration Of The ‘Value’ Investing Mindset
summary: This article argues for Intel as a "value investment" due to its current undervaluation despite strong long-term prospects. It delves into strategic market trends, Intel's strong industry position, favorable political and geopolitical factors, and a revived company culture under CEO Pat Gelsinger. The author emphasizes that true "value investing" focuses on a company's ability to correct its problems and adapt to strategic environmental shifts over a multi-year horizon, rather than short-term financial details.

title: Opinion: Why Nvidia investors are rattled by Supermicro’s AI chip supply constraints
summary: Nvidia investors are concerned by AI chip supply constraints reported by Supermicro, a Silicon Valley computer and server maker. Supermicro's executives stated they need more AI chips from Nvidia, confirming existing supply limitations for Nvidia's popular graphics chips. This suggests that the high demand for AI applications may face hardware availability issues.

title: 3 Growth ETFs To Avoid in 2023
summary: This article identifies three growth ETFs—Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ), ARK Innovation ETF (ARKK), and AI Powered Equity ETF (AIEQ)—that investors should consider avoiding in 2023. The author, Bryan Armour, CFA, discusses concerns such as high concentration, performance chasing, high turnover, and valuation issues for these funds, despite growth stocks performing well year-to-date. The piece advises investors to focus on long-term strategies rather than chasing past performance in a market with stretched valuations and continued uncertainty.

title: SK Telecom to invest $100M in AI company Anthropic
summary: SK Telecom announced a $100 million investment in U.S. AI company Anthropic to expand its presence in the AI sector and collaborate on developing an AI platform and large language model. This partnership is expected to accelerate the development of the global Telco AI Platform, aligning with SK Telecom's broader strategy to foster an AI ecosystem with international telecommunications companies. Anthropic's chief scientist will lead the development of a new LLM supporting multiple languages, including Korean, English, German, and Japanese.

title: 4 AI-powered ETFs: Pros and cons of AI stockpicking funds
summary: This article explores AI-powered Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs), discussing how they use machine learning to select stocks and the potential benefits and drawbacks. It details four specific AI-driven ETFs, highlighting their assets under management and expense ratios. The piece emphasizes that while AI stock-picking is thrilling, it's still in its early stages and investors should consider their needs and costs.

title: Intel’s Terminated $5.4B Tower Acquisition: 5 Big Things To Know
summary: Intel terminated its $5.4 billion acquisition of Tower Semiconductor due to regulatory approval issues, a setback for CEO Pat Gelsinger's IDM 2.0 strategy and Intel Foundry Services. The deal's failure, possibly due to U.S.-China geopolitical tensions, resulted in a $353 million termination fee. Despite this, Intel remains committed to its foundry business, aiming to become the second-largest global external foundry by 2030, though Tower's capacity and customer base would have provided a significant boost.

title: Kneron unveils lower-cost, energy-efficient AI chip
summary: Kneron Inc, an AI chip start-up, has introduced its new KL730 AI chip as a more cost-effective and energy-efficient alternative to Nvidia's GPUs for generative AI solutions. The KL730, which uses TSMC's 12-nanometer process, is designed to reduce operational costs significantly and is 150-200% more energy-efficient than competitors' products. Kneron expects autonomous vehicles and servers to be major applications for its NPU technology, with customer sampling for the KL730 beginning by year-end.

title: Hesai Reports Record Lidar Sales, Revenue
summary: Hesai Technology (NASDAQ: HSAI) reported record-breaking unaudited financial results for Q2 2023, with quarterly revenue reaching RMB440.3 million ($60.7 million), a 108.5% YoY increase. The company shipped 52,106 lidar units, a 946.5% YoY increase, significantly driven by ADAS lidar growth. Hesai also solidified its position as the No. 1 global automotive lidar supplier, secured new design wins with major OEMs, and deepened its collaboration with NVIDIA.

title: LX International liquidates Yantai LCD component warehouse in China
summary: LX International has liquidated its Yantai LCD component warehouse in China due to decreased demand for LCD panels, particularly from key customer LG Display. This move follows LG Display's reduction in LCD module production at its Yantai plant as the market shifts from LCD to OLED technology for small panels. The liquidation reflects the evolving display market where OLED is expected to significantly increase its share in IT devices.

title: TSMC’s CoWoS Dominance: Amkor, ASE, JCET’s Response
summary: The article discusses how the increasing demand for high-performance computing, AI, and 5G has led to a shift towards advanced packaging techniques like 2.5D and 3D, exemplified by TSMC's CoWoS technology. Despite TSMC's significant role, traditional assembly and test firms such as ASE, Amkor, and JCET are actively developing their own advanced packaging solutions to remain competitive. These firms are securing partial orders and maintaining market share by catering to products not in the highest-end category, showcasing their continued relevance alongside wafer foundries.

title: Report: AI startup Hugging Face hoping to raise millions from Salesforce and other investors
summary: AI startup Hugging Face is reportedly seeking to raise $200 million in venture capital, with Salesforce Inc. expected to lead the funding round. This investment would more than double Hugging Face's current $2 billion valuation, bringing it to $4 billion. The funds will support its platform which hosts over 100,000 open-source AI models and offers paid functionalities like AutoTrain and Inference API.

title: 'Mad Money' ETF to close after attracting just $1.3M
summary: The Long Cramer Tracker ETF (LJIM), which aimed to mirror Jim Cramer's stock picks, is set to close just five months after its launch due to its inability to attract significant assets or engagement from Cramer himself. Despite outperforming its bearish counterpart, the Inverse Cramer Tracker ETF (SJIM), LJIM only gathered $1.3 million and saw a 2.2% gain. Tuttle Capital Management will now focus solely on the Inverse Cramer Tracker ETF.

title: NVD - GraniteShares 2x Short NVDA Daily ETF Stock Price and Quote
summary: This article provides detailed stock price and quote information for the GraniteShares 2x Short NVDA Daily ETF (NVD), an exchange-traded fund designed to deliver inverse daily returns of NVIDIA Corporation's stock. It includes performance metrics, financial data, and relevant news headlines. The ETF aims to replicate -1.5 times the daily percentage change of NVIDIA's common stock through swap agreements.

title: GraniteShares' Single Stock ETFs Will Follow Nvidia, Tesla, AMD
summary: GraniteShares has launched four new single-stock ETFs to capitalize on the trading momentum of Nvidia, Tesla, and Advanced Micro Devices. These new ETFs offer unique leveraged and short exposures, with the GraniteShares 1.5x Short NVDA Daily ETF (NVD) launching just before Nvidia's earnings report. The asset manager plans to roll out almost three dozen more such filings, emphasizing being first to market with these trading-focused products.

title: Arm, the Chip Designer, Files for an I.P.O. Expected to Be Among the Largest (Published 2023)
summary: Arm, the chip design company owned by SoftBank, has filed for an initial public offering (IPO) on the Nasdaq exchange, which is anticipated to be one of the largest in recent years. This move follows Nvidia's abandoned bid to acquire Arm for $40 billion 18 months prior. The IPO will provide SoftBank with additional capital for investments, and SoftBank will retain its position as Arm's controlling shareholder.

title: Stock movers: Nvidia, iTeos, Arcus, Manchester United, Nike, AMC, Bath & Body Works and more
summary: This article details the stock movements of several major companies on August 23, 2023. Nvidia saw a slight increase ahead of its quarterly financials, while iTeos Therapeutics and Arcus Biosciences surged due to leaked Roche clinical trial data. Mallinckrodt PLC's shares dropped as it announced plans for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, and AMC Entertainment Holdings continued to fall before its APE unit conversion. Manchester United stock rallied on takeover speculation, Nike declined following Foot Locker's profit warning, and Abercrombie & Fitch and Bath & Body Works experienced positive movements after their financial reports.

title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2024
summary: NVIDIA reported record revenue of $13.51 billion for the second quarter of fiscal 2024, a 101% increase from a year ago, driven by strong growth in Data Center revenue at $10.32 billion. The company also announced a new $25.00 billion share repurchase authorization and provided a positive outlook for the third quarter, expecting revenue of $16.00 billion. The CEO highlighted the ongoing transition to accelerated computing and generative AI as key drivers for NVIDIA's success.

title: Technical Analysis of GraniteShares 2x Short NVDA Daily ETF (NASDAQ:NVD)
summary: This article provides a technical analysis of the GraniteShares 2x Short NVDA Daily ETF (NVD) using various indicators. It summarizes signals from moving averages, oscillators, and pivots across different timeframes, offering insights into potential buy, sell, or neutral trends. The analysis also includes an FAQ section explaining key technical analysis concepts and their application to NVD.

title: Bullish on Nvidia? This single-stock ETF could offer 1.5 times leverage on the popular chip stock — but be careful what you wish for.
summary: This article discusses single-stock ETFs, focusing on those linked to Nvidia following its strong earnings report. It highlights how these ETFs offer leveraged exposure to the chipmaker, which is a key player in the AI industry, while also cautioning potential investors about the inherent risks.

title: AMD debuts two new graphics cards for the consumer market
summary: AMD has introduced two new graphics cards, the Radeon RX 7800 XT and RX 7700 XT, to compete with Nvidia in the consumer chip market. These cards, priced at $499 and $449 respectively, are positioned as more affordable alternatives to high-end GPUs while offering significant performance per dollar. Based on AMD's latest RDNA 3 architecture, they include features like upgraded machine learning accelerators, ray tracing optimization, and FSR 3 technology for improved gaming visuals.

title: Nvidia Stock Is a Top Holding in These Tech ETFs
summary: Nvidia Corporation (NVDA) is a top holding in many tech, AI, and semiconductor ETFs due to its crucial role in manufacturing GPUs that power AI applications. Despite potential challenges like competition and geopolitical factors, Nvidia's innovative technology and market dominance make it a key component for investors seeking exposure to the rapidly growing AI market. ETFs like the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the Strive U.S. Semiconductor ETF (SHOC) have significant allocations to NVDA, reflecting its importance in the sector.

title: Hedge fund exposure to 7 biggest tech stocks at record high, Goldman Sachs says
summary: Hedge funds have reached record exposure to the seven largest tech stocks by market capitalization, according to Goldman Sachs data, driven by strong performance and the artificial intelligence theme. These seven stocks, including Nvidia, Apple, and Microsoft, now constitute about 20% of the total net market value held by hedge funds tracked by Goldman Sachs. Despite the concentration risk, investment managers rationalize these allocations due to the significant returns generated by these companies this year.

title: Institute for National Defense and Security Research-Newsletter
summary: This article analyzes the impact of the Matsu undersea cable interruption on Taiwan's national defense and security, emphasizing the critical role of submarine cables for communication and military operations. It highlights how the CCP's grey zone tactics, including cable damage, undermine Taiwan's cyber resilience and calls for establishing comprehensive backup mechanisms, strengthening network infrastructure, and developing low-orbit satellites, drawing lessons from the Russo-Ukrainian War, to enhance Taiwan's communication system. The author stresses the need for integration between military and civilian technological capabilities and international cooperation to secure national communication.

title: How space traffic in orbit could spell trouble on Earth
summary: The increasing number of satellites in Earth's orbit, particularly large constellations like Starlink, significantly raises the risk of catastrophic collisions and the generation of more space debris. Such collisions could disrupt vital services on Earth, including GPS, communication, weather forecasting, and intelligence gathering. The current patchwork of international regulations is insufficient to manage this growing traffic, highlighting the urgent need for a formal, coordinated global system to prevent disasters and maintain the functionality of orbital infrastructure.

title: VinFast market cap reaches $191B, comparable to Tesla’s valuation in 2020
summary: Vietnamese EV maker VinFast (NASDAQ:VFS) achieved a market capitalization of $190 billion, making it the third most valuable carmaker globally, a valuation Tesla reached in 2020. This milestone is notable given VinFast's relatively low sales of 24,000 cars in 2022 compared to Tesla's established leadership when it hit a similar valuation. The high market cap is partly attributed to a limited float, with founder Pham Nhat Vuong controlling 99% of shares, which causes significant stock volatility.

title: Why Is Ambarella (AMBA) Stock Down 20% Today?
summary: Ambarella (AMBA) stock dropped nearly 20% after the company reported a disappointing quarter and cut its sales outlook. The chipmaker, which specializes in AI vision processors for applications like police body cameras and self-driving cars, cited aggressive inventory cutting by customers and weak end-market demand. Despite the CEO's anticipation of a return to growth next fiscal year, the company remains unprofitable and its market capitalization is significantly higher than its annual sales.

title: Cathie Wood Just Sold Nvidia -- and Bought These 5 Potentially Explosive Growth Stocks Again
summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest firm sold 3,952 shares of Nvidia from its Ark Genomic Revolution ETF for approximately $1.9 million despite Nvidia's strong Q2 earnings. Concurrent with this sale, Ark Invest purchased shares in five biotech growth stocks: Intellia Therapeutics, Invitae, Accolade, CRISPR Therapeutics, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals, signaling a strategic shift towards the biotech sector for potential explosive growth. Wood has been increasing her firm's biotech holdings in both the Genomic Revolution ETF and the flagship Ark Innovation ETF, suggesting a belief that biotech offers the best return potential for growth investors currently.

title: Meet Five Generative AI Innovators in Africa and the Middle East
summary: This article highlights five generative AI innovators across Africa and the Middle East who are customizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for their respective markets. It features startups like MazzumaGPT in Ghana, which helps developers draft smart contracts, and MetaDialog in Dubai, which built the first LLM to support both Arabic and English. Beyond Limits in Abu Dhabi is also noted for training and fine-tuning LLMs for corporations, with all three companies benefiting from NVIDIA's Inception program.

title: AI In Medical Devices Global Market Report 2023: Unveiling
summary: The "AI In Medical Devices Global Market Report 2023" indicates significant growth in the AI in medical devices market, projected to reach $66.35 billion by 2027 from $10.64 billion in 2022. Key drivers include technological advancements like Nvidia's Clara Holoscan MGX platform and increasing demand for AI-integrated wearables for health monitoring. Major players are also expanding through acquisitions to enhance their AI capabilities in healthcare.

title: XOMO - YieldMax XOM Option Income Strategy ETF Stock Price and Quote
summary: This article provides a detailed quote and financial data for the XOMO - YieldMax XOM Option Income Strategy ETF. It includes current stock price, performance metrics, dividend information, fund characteristics, and recent news announcements related to YieldMax ETFs. The fund aims for current income and indirect exposure to Exxon Mobil Corporation (XOM) through a synthetic covered call strategy.

title: Coherent to set up centre of excellence at IIT-Madras Research Park
summary: American firm Coherent has signed a tripartite memorandum of understanding with Guidance Tamil Nadu and IIT-Madras Research Park (IITMRP) to establish its first global Centre of Excellence (CoE) in India on the IITMRP campus. This CoE will focus on R&D for lasers, optical networking components, EV batteries, and compound semiconductor devices. The company plans to hire technical talent and start with an applications engineering lab for laser materials processing, leveraging Tamil Nadu's innovation ecosystem and engineering talent.

title: Qualcomm CEO says AI may breathe new life into smartphones: 'It could create a new upgrade cycle'
summary: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon believes artificial intelligence could spark a new upgrade cycle for smartphones, revitalizing a market that saw a significant sales decline in 2022. Amon indicated that the company's upcoming Snapdragon Summit in October would showcase new AI-driven use cases from smartphone manufacturers. Unlike Nvidia's focus on data centers, Qualcomm aims to bring AI capabilities directly to devices, enhancing user experience and driving demand for new models.

title: SOXQ ETF: Huawei's Latest Phone And Implication For Semis Stocks
summary: Huawei has launched the Mate 60, a new 5G smartphone, signaling its recovery from past sanctions and strengthening China's semiconductor industry. This development poses competitive risks for holdings within the Invesco PHLX Semiconductor ETF (SOXQ). Given these implications for the semiconductor market, the author maintains a "Hold" position on SOXQ.

title: Nvidia Says It Will Invest In Arm’s IPO After Failed Acquisition
summary: Nvidia has confirmed its intention to invest in Arm's initial public offering, despite its failed acquisition attempt of the company. The GPU giant was named as a potential "cornerstone investor" in Arm's updated IPO filing, alongside other tech companies like Intel, AMD, Apple, and Google. This investment highlights the continued importance of Arm's architecture to Nvidia's products and the broader tech ecosystem.

title: POET Technologies’ New Module Designs Attract Major Companies at CIOE
summary: POET Technologies' joint exhibition with Super Photonics Xiamen (SPX) at CIOE in Shenzhen was a significant success, leading to numerous customer engagements and requests for samples of their 800G and 400G optical engines. The company's new module designs, based on the POET Optical Interposer, simplify assembly by eliminating the need for active alignments and attracted major end-users like Alibaba, FiberHome, and ByteDance. The positive reception at the event signals strong near-term commercial activity for POET.

title: Seagate And Western Digital: Benefiting From AI And Generative AI Storage Demand (STX)
summary: The article discusses how Seagate and Western Digital are poised to benefit from the increasing demand for data storage driven by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and generative AI. It highlights that AI applications require extensive memory and storage, positioning Hard Disk Drives (HDDs) from these companies to dominate data centers for the next decade. Advanced technologies like HAMR from Seagate and MAMR from Western Digital are expected to keep HDDs competitive against SSDs through 2030.

title: Building safe, secure and trustworthy AI: Adobe’s commitments to our customers and community
summary: Adobe outlines its commitment to safe, secure, and trustworthy AI development, aligning with the White House Voluntary AI Commitments. The company emphasizes rigorous testing, security measures, and the development of Content Credentials to enhance transparency and combat misinformation in AI-generated content. Furthermore, Adobe pledges to empower creators by enabling "Do Not Train" tags and advocating for federal anti-impersonation rights to protect artists in the AI era.

title: Arm, the Chip Designer, Raises $4.87 Billion in the Year’s Largest I.P.O. (Published 2023)
summary: Arm, the British chip design company, successfully raised $4.87 billion in the largest initial public offering of the year, valuing the company at $54.5 billion. This I.P.O. is a significant event for SoftBank, which acquired Arm in 2016 and aims to capitalize on the tech industry's focus on artificial intelligence, following a failed acquisition bid by Nvidia. Arm's return to public markets under the ticker symbol ARM is being closely watched as a gauge of investor interest in new tech offerings.

title: AIoT Platforms Are on the Rise, But What Are They?
summary: This article explains the concept of AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things) platforms, which integrate AI programming into IoT devices to enhance functionality and efficiency. It details real-world applications across smart homes, edge computing, healthcare, and smart cities, highlighting the projected rapid growth of the AIoT market. The piece emphasizes the transformative potential of AIoT for industries, resource optimization, and decision-making.

title: Chipmaker Arm is valued at $55 billion after a blockbuster IPO that is this year's biggest by far
summary: Arm Holdings successfully priced its IPO at the top of its range, raising $4.87 billion and achieving a valuation of approximately $54.5 billion. This marks the largest listing of the year globally and is expected to invigorate the equity markets and a pipeline of other tech IPOs. SoftBank will retain about 90% ownership after the offering, which saw significant investment from major tech companies like Intel, Apple, and Nvidia.

title: Check out Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 2X Shares's stock price (NVDU) in real time
summary: This article provides real-time stock price information for Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 2X Shares (NVDU), including current trading data, key statistics, and historical performance. It details the stock's last price, volume, 52-week range, and dividend information. The page also offers a summary of events, but notes there is no recent news for the security.

title: Arm climbs 25% in Nasdaq debut after pricing IPO at $51 a share
summary: Arm Holdings saw its stock jump nearly 25% on its first day of trading on the Nasdaq after pricing its IPO at $51 per share, valuing the company at almost $60 billion. SoftBank, which took Arm private in 2016, retains about 90% of the company's outstanding shares. Despite its high valuation relative to its current growth, Arm's unique royalty-based business model, including revenue from decades-old designs, and its strategic importance in AI and chip design, are key factors in investor interest.

title: Invesco MSCI USA ETF (PBUS) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the Invesco MSCI USA ETF (PBUS), including its current stock price, key statistics like PE Ratio and Dividend Yield, and its top holdings as of August 31, 2025. The ETF has a portfolio value of $8.44 billion with top holdings including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, and Meta Platforms. It also presents historical performance data and breakdowns of asset allocation and sector exposure.

title: Equal Weight ETF EQL Hits Key Buy Signal
summary: The article highlights the Alps Equal Sector Weight ETF (EQL) as an intriguing tool to mitigate concentration risk in the S&P 500, particularly due to the dominance of a few tech firms. EQL, an equal-weight ETF, assigns equal weight to each sector and then to stocks within those sectors, offering diversification and strong performance. The fund hit a key buy signal as its price rose above its 50-day simple moving average.

title: Arm’s shares seen as a shoo-in for Nasdaq 100, though S&P 500 unlikely
summary: Newly public Arm Holdings is expected to join the Nasdaq 100 index due to its market capitalization and potential for rapid inclusion of megacap growth companies. However, its inclusion in the S&P 500 is unlikely, primarily because it is a UK-based multinational company, which conflicts with the S&P 500's focus on the U.S. economy. Additionally, a low public float due to SoftBank's significant stake might pose a barrier to inclusion in some other indexes and ETFs.

title: Chip Stocks Drop After Report Says TSMC Is Worried About Demand
summary: Chip stocks dropped following a report that Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC), the world's largest third-party semiconductor manufacturer, has expressed concerns about slowing chip demand. TSMC reportedly told its suppliers to delay some deliveries, indicating potential weakness in the broader chip market. This news directly impacted investor sentiment towards the technology sector.

title: iShares MSCI ACWI ETF
summary: The iShares MSCI ACWI ETF (ACWI) offers investors global equity exposure to large and mid-capitalization developed and emerging markets. It tracks the MSCI All Country World Index, providing diversification across numerous countries and sectors efficiently. The ETF is marketed as a low-cost investment vehicle with potential for long-term growth, though it acknowledges inherent investment risks.

title: Intel pitches the 'AI PC' at software developer event
summary: Intel announced a new "Meteor Lake" chip, expected in December, that will enable generative AI chatbots to run directly on laptops without needing cloud data centers. This development, showcased at a software developer conference, aims to offer businesses and consumers greater privacy and faster AI responses for ChatGPT-style technologies. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger positioned this as a "sea change moment" for tech innovation, with the company also announcing plans for a successor chip and partnerships in the AI space.

title: Infosys and NVIDIA expand partnership to build generative AI for businesses
summary: Infosys and NVIDIA have expanded their partnership to create a generative AI platform aimed at boosting enterprise productivity. This collaboration will leverage computer vision and NVIDIA's NeMo framework to address various industry challenges, including retail inventory management and customer service, while integrating Infosys’ Responsible AI Toolkit to mitigate risks. Infosys also plans to establish a NVIDIA Centre of Excellence to train 50,000 staff in generative AI technologies.

title: Silicon Hegemon: Could China Take Over Taiwan’s Semiconductor Industry Without Invading?
summary: This article explores the high-impact, low-probability scenario of China taking control of Taiwan's semiconductor industry, particularly TSMC, without a full-scale military invasion. It outlines hypothetical coercion tactics short of war, such as blockades and economic pressure, that could force Taiwan into ceding control. The authors propose military, regulatory, and policy responses for Taiwan and its allies to prevent such an outcome, emphasizing deterrence and preparedness to defend free passage to and from Taiwan.

title: Supermicro At 30: From Designing AI Chips To Selling AI Systems
summary: Supermicro, founded 30 years ago, began with Charles Liang's vision to improve server motherboards and power supplies after working on an AI processor design. The company has grown into a $10 billion systems business with global manufacturing facilities and aims for $20 billion in the next three years, continuously expanding its operations and exploring new factory locations.

title: Nvidia's French offices raided in cloud-computing competition inquiry, Wall Street Journal reports
summary: French competition authorities raided Nvidia's offices on suspicion of anticompetitive practices related to cloud computing and graphics cards. The investigation, part of a broader inquiry into potential market dominance in cloud computing, follows Nvidia's significant growth partly due to rising demand for its AI chips. This action aligns with France's recent aggressive stance against large tech companies.

title: CHPS ETF Analysis: Dividends, Returns NEO:CHPS
summary: This article provides a detailed analysis of the CHPS ETF, Global X Artificial Intelligence Semiconductor Index ETF Class A. It covers key statistics such as Assets Under Management, expense ratio, dividend yield, and issuer information. The article also breaks down the fund's holdings by sector and region, discusses its performance, and answers frequently asked questions regarding its investments, dividends, and AUM.

title: Palantir: Implications Of The $28B Mega Cisco-Splunk Deal (NYSE:PLTR)
summary: Cisco's $28 billion acquisition of Splunk underscores the increasing value of AI capabilities in the industry, raising questions about potential takeover targets. Palantir Technologies, with its aggressive focus on AI and growth in Business Intelligence, is identified as a possible acquisition candidate. This deal highlights the broader trend of large corporations seeking to acquire advanced AI capabilities for long-term revenue growth.

title: Blackberry to Split in Two: Why We Like the Idea
summary: BlackBerry announced its intention to split into two distinct businesses: IoT and cybersecurity. Morningstar analysts view this separation positively, especially the IoT business which includes the QNX software for autonomous vehicles, as it is considered the most valuable part of the firm and an attractive investment. The cybersecurity segment, while struggling, is also expected to benefit from better execution as a separate entity and could be an attractive buyout candidate.

title: NVIDIA Corp (NVDA) DCF Valuation: Is The Stock Undervalued?
summary: This article analyzes NVIDIA (NVDA) using a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation model to determine if the stock is undervalued. Based on the DCF analysis, NVIDIA's stock, with a DCF value of $75.03 per share against a market price of $440.41, is considered significantly overvalued, showing a negative margin of safety. The author emphasizes that this is a simplified analysis and advises readers to conduct their own thorough research before making investment decisions.

title: Tech spared as bond selloff buffets stocks
summary: Treasury yields surged to their highest levels in over a decade as traders anticipated prolonged high borrowing costs from the Federal Reserve, impacting most US stocks. However, the Nasdaq 100, driven by major technology firms like Microsoft, Apple, and Nvidia, saw gains. This market movement occurred despite a last-minute deal to avert a government shutdown, highlighting the market's primary focus on interest rate policy.

title: REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF (FEPI) Price, Holdings, & News
summary: The REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF (FEPI) is an actively managed exchange-traded fund launched on October 9, 2023. It aims to mirror the returns of the Solactive FANG Innovation Index while generating monthly income by investing in index securities and writing call options. The fund currently has $584.04 million in assets under management and a dividend yield of 27.49%.

title: NVIDIA Omniverse is Changing Filmmaking and Exxact is Helping It Happen
summary: The article highlights how NVIDIA Omniverse and Exxact Corporation are revolutionizing filmmaking, especially in animation and VFX, by enabling real-time virtual production. It showcases how companies like Sony Pictures Animation, disguise, and Versatile Media are using Omniverse to improve workflows, accelerate production, and facilitate remote collaboration. Exxact Corporation provides integrated, high-performance computing solutions to help these companies adopt Omniverse Enterprise.

title: IDC report: AI and DL storage infrastructure
summary: This article highlights an IDC report on AI and deep learning (DL) storage infrastructure, emphasizing the growing need for enterprise-class storage solutions to support AI applications. The report discusses key considerations for AI storage training infrastructure, enterprise deployment models, and why scaling beyond NFS is crucial. It also positions NetApp as a strong contender for AI-driven workloads due to its performance, scalability, and partnerships with hyperscalers.

title: Amkor's Largest Global Semiconductor Factory Opens in Yen Phong 2C Industrial Park developed by Viglacera
summary: Amkor Technology Vietnam celebrated the grand opening of its largest global semiconductor factory in the Yen Phong 2C Industrial Park, developed by Viglacera Corporation. This advanced factory, with a $1.6 billion investment, will serve leading electronics companies and is expected to boost Vietnam's semiconductor industry. Viglacera, with over 20 years of experience in industrial real estate, continues to attract significant foreign direct investment, especially in high-tech sectors, and plans further expansion of its industrial park network.

title: Supermicro Accelerates Everything at ISC23
summary: Supermicro showcased its latest High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions at ISC23 in Hamburg, Germany, emphasizing its leadership in AI infrastructure. Key highlights included liquid-cooled NVIDIA HGX H100 GPU servers, an AI development platform with NVIDIA, and an 8U PVC system featuring Intel Data Series GPUs. The company also presented high-performance storage solutions optimized for AI workloads, demonstrating its commitment to accelerating AI adoption.

title: Beamr Issues Q3-2023 CEO Letter to Shareholders
summary: Beamr's CEO Sharon Carmel issued a letter to shareholders detailing Q3 2023 activities and progress, highlighting reaching $1.4M in revenues from Q1-Q3 2023 and $5.4M in cash and cash equivalents. The company also announced signing another top-five media company as a client and is on track to launch its new Beamr SaaS in Q1 2024, expecting revenue ramp-up in 2024. Collaboration with Nvidia continues, and Beamr is expanding sales and marketing capabilities in preparation for the SaaS launch.

title: BigBear.ai (BBAI) Enhances Military Planning Through AFRL
summary: BigBear.ai (BBAI) has expanded its commitment to the Air Force Research Laboratory’s (AFRL) Composable Collaborative Planning BAA, significantly advancing military planning processes by delivering resource-informed plans in under a month. The company's AI-driven solutions are gaining prominence, with partnerships like Autodesk integration and substantial contracts, demonstrating its impact in military technology. BigBear.ai's stock has outperformed the Zacks Computer and Technology sector, reflecting strong growth and promising future revenue expectations.

title: BlackLine (BL) Strengthens Portfolio With Microsoft Teams Integration
summary: BlackLine (BL) has integrated Microsoft Teams and introduced enhanced capabilities for its Microsoft Dynamics 365 Connector to streamline finance and accounting processes. This partnership offers seamless compatibility with Microsoft ERPs, providing real-time notifications and improved data access. BlackLine also highlighted its robust portfolio, including recent acquisitions, AI-enabled solutions, and strong customer growth, expecting significant revenue for fiscal 2023.

title: Supermicro Starts Shipments of NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip-Based Servers, the Industry's First Family of NVIDIA MGX Systems
summary: Supermicro announces the shipment of new GPU systems based on the NVIDIA reference architecture, featuring NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper and NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip. These systems, designed with a modular architecture for AI infrastructure, are the industry's first family of NVIDIA MGX Systems. Supermicro highlights their advanced liquid-cooling technology and ability to deliver thousands of rack-scale AI servers per month, accelerating time to market for AI-enabled applications.

title: ASML voices common concerns of global chip industry over US’ new export curbs
summary: ASML and other international semiconductor companies are concerned about the US' escalating export curbs on advanced AI chips to China, as these restrictions threaten their sales and market share in the vast Chinese market. The article highlights that these US policies are not only impacting American businesses like Nvidia, Intel, and Qualcomm but are also pushing China towards accelerated independent chip development, ultimately leading to a lose-lose situation for all involved.

title: Dow Theory Letters - REX Shares Partners with Tuttle Capital Management to Launch T-REX Single-Stock ETFs
summary: REX Shares and Tuttle Capital Management have partnered to launch T-REX Single-Stock ETFs, offering targeted 200% and -200% exposure to Tesla and NVIDIA. This new suite of ETFs, including TSLT, TSLZ, NVDX, and NVDQ, is designed for sophisticated traders seeking to enhance potential returns through pinpoint positioning. The launch follows REX Shares' recent introduction of the REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF (FEPI), further expanding their innovative product offerings.

title: HPE delivers Austral supercomputer to CRIANN in France
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has delivered a new AI supercomputer named Austral to CRIANN in France. This 2 petaflops system, co-funded by the Normandy Region, French State, and EU, will be used for AI model training and simulations in various fields such as climate modeling, biotechnology, and healthcare. Austral features AMD Genoa, Intel Cooper Lake cores, and Nvidia A100 GPUs, and is hosted in a customized HPE HPC pod with direct liquid cooling.

title: Cathie Wood explains how the artificial intelligence boom could propel Ark's Innovation ETF
summary: Cathie Wood believes the artificial intelligence boom could significantly boost Ark Invest's flagship Ark Innovation ETF (ARKK). While the fund has gained 17% this year, Wood emphasized that AI represents a reality, not just a dream, and that its disruptive nature will create new industry leaders. She cautioned investors to be discerning with their AI bets, highlighting Tesla as a key holding while expressing reservations about some other "Magnificent Seven" stocks.

title: Bitcoin Miner Bit Digital Diversifies Into AI for 'Substantially Higher Margin' Than Mining
summary: Bitcoin miner Bit Digital (BTBT) is diversifying its revenue streams by expanding into the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure business, anticipating "substantially higher margins" than its traditional bitcoin mining and ether staking operations. The company signed a deal with an AI firm to provide cloud-based GPU resources, expected to generate over $250 million in additional revenue over three years, funded by a $35 million investment in GPUs. This strategic move aims to create a reliable income stream uncorrelated to bitcoin prices, helping the company weather potential downturns in the crypto market and upcoming halving events.

title: Nvidia and AMD reportedly developing Arm-based PC processors
summary: Nvidia and AMD are reportedly developing new Arm-based PC processors, aiming to enter the Windows computer market as early as 2025. This move aligns with Microsoft's efforts to foster competition and introduce more energy-efficient CPUs with advanced AI features, similar to Apple's Arm-based Macs. Qualcomm currently holds an exclusivity agreement with Microsoft for Arm-based Windows chips, which is set to expire by the end of the year, potentially opening the door for Nvidia and AMD.

title: Nvidia to take on Intel, Qualcomm with Arm-based processors for PC; availability pegged for 2025
summary: Nvidia is developing Arm-based processors for personal computers, aiming to compete with Intel and Qualcomm, with availability expected as soon as 2025. This move intensifies competition in the PC chip market, especially as AMD is also reportedly working on Arm-based processors for PCs. The initiative follows Apple's successful transition to in-house Arm-based chips, boosting Mac sales, and poses a significant challenge to Intel's dominant position.

title: Will Super Micro Computer Be a Trillion-Dollar Stock by 2050?
summary: This article examines the potential for Super Micro Computer (Supermicro) to reach a $1 trillion valuation by 2050, driven by the booming AI market. It outlines a mathematical case for growth based on revenue projections and market valuations, acknowledging Supermicro's strong performance as an AI stock. However, the author cautions against over-optimistic long-term predictions, citing potential risks like acquisitions, new competitors, geopolitical tensions, and economic downturns, suggesting investors should instead focus on the company's more foreseeable future.

title: Google, Nvidia Back AI Startup That Helps Combat Chip Shortage
summary: CentML, an AI startup focused on improving the efficiency of machine learning systems, has raised $27 million in a seed funding round. The investment, backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Nvidia Corp., Radical Ventures, Deloitte Ventures, and Thomson Reuters Ventures, aims to help developers optimize computing power for AI training, which could alleviate chip shortages.

title: Shutterstock Integrates AI Into Its Library of 700 Million Images
summary: Shutterstock has launched Creative AI, a new generative AI tool integrated into its vast library of over 700 million images. This tool, powered by OpenAI's Dall-E, allows users to generate, edit, and expand images, making customized content easier to produce. Shutterstock emphasizes that its AI is trained on licensed content and that contributors are compensated, addressing concerns about unauthorized AI image generation.

title: Microsoft will hold a 27% stake in OpenAI and gain access to its AI models.
summary: Microsoft and OpenAI have finalized a new agreement where Microsoft will acquire a 27% stake in OpenAI, valued at $135 billion. This agreement grants Microsoft access to OpenAI's AI technology, including AGI models, until 2032. OpenAI has also committed to investing an additional $250 billion in purchasing Azure services.

title: Bargain Hunting in Semiconductor Stocks: Down 25%, Texas Instruments Is a Top Stock to Buy
summary: Texas Instruments (TXN) shares have underperformed recently due to a cyclical downturn in the semiconductor industry, while competitors like Nvidia and Taiwan Semiconductor have risen. Despite this, Motley Fool contributors Jason Hall and Jeff Santoro argue that the company remains a strong long-term investment. They believe that looking beyond current weaknesses reveals significant future growth potential for Texas Instruments.

title: Jidu launches AI-based robocar in China
summary: Jidu Auto, a joint venture between Geely and Baidu, has launched its first AI-powered battery electric vehicle, the Ji Yue 01, in China. This "robocar" features Baidu's Apollo Level 4 autonomous driving technology and advanced intelligent cockpit systems. Despite cutting-edge technology, the CEO acknowledges the need to build brand awareness to gain significant market share.

title: Insight 2023: NetApp Enhanced Data Pipeline for Hybrid Multi-Cloud AI and Advancements on Secure Storage Vs. Ransomware
summary: NetApp announced significant portfolio updates at Insight 2023, focusing on enhancements to its data pipeline for hybrid multi-cloud AI and advancements in secure storage against ransomware. The company is simplifying AI data pipeline deployment across hybrid multi-cloud environments, while also strengthening data protection with features like autonomous ransomware detection and an extended Ransomware Recovery Guarantee. These innovations aim to address the dual challenges of leveraging AI opportunities and mitigating ransomware threats for customers.

title: Will AI Spark a Boom in Data Centre Real Estate?
summary: The article discusses how the rise of AI and other disruptive technologies is driving an increase in demand for data centers, potentially tripling global capacity in six years. It highlights data center real estate stocks, such as Digital Realty Trust and Global X's Data Centre REITs & Digital Infrastructure ETF, as a focused investment opportunity, noting their inflation-resistant nature and tax benefits. The article also touches on the geographical shift in data center placement, with growth in less expensive locations like the US Midwest.

title: How To Give Your Passive Investing Approach Some Much-Needed Oomph
summary: This article explores factor investing, also known as "smart beta," as a way to enhance passive investing strategies. It discusses the performance of five popular factors—value, quality, momentum, minimum volatility, and size—highlighting quality as the best performer over the past five years. The piece also suggests considering multifactor ETFs like the iShares US Equity Factor ETF (LRGF) for diversified exposure to these factors.

title: Hartford Funds Seeks to Let $4.1B Fund Make More Concentrated Investments
summary: Hartford Funds is proposing to reclassify its $4.1 billion Growth Opportunities Fund as a non-diversified investment, which would allow it to make more concentrated investments. This change, if approved by shareholders, would increase the fund's risk profile and volatility, prompting plan sponsors and fiduciaries to re-evaluate their inclusion of the fund in retirement lineups. The reclassification comes as allocations to a few mega-cap tech stocks have pushed some diversified funds to exceed investment thresholds.

title: AMD soars as AI chip sales prediction bodes well for rivalry with Nvidia
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares jumped 8% after CEO Lisa Su provided an upbeat 2024 sales forecast of over $2 billion for its MI300 AI chips, positioning AMD as a clear second source to Nvidia in the AI accelerator market. This prediction helped alleviate concerns about a disappointing fourth-quarter forecast despite at least 18 analysts cutting price targets due to conservative forecasts and weakness in other AMD markets. The MI300 is set to become AMD's fastest product to reach $1 billion in sales, having secured commitments from multiple large hyperscale customers.

title: Automotive Digitalization Sparks Big Growth For Chips And Design Tools
summary: The automotive industry is experiencing significant growth in semiconductor dependency due to innovations like autonomous driving, advanced driver-assist features, and infotainment systems. This surge is driven by the adoption of a "software-defined vehicle" concept and a scalable, zonal digital chassis architecture. Companies like Cadence Design Systems are playing a crucial role by providing tools for chip design, system modeling, simulation, and multiphysics analysis to support this technological transformation.

title: Super Micro stock has surged this year, but investors may be overlooking a risk
summary: Super Micro Computer Inc., a partner of Nvidia, has seen its stock surge over 200% this year, fueled by AI-ready server sales. The company reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $2.12 billion and raised its annual guidance to between $10 billion and $11 billion. However, investors are cautioned that the company's increasing reliance on AI-related server sales (now over half its revenue) could pose a risk.

title: Raspberry Pi Receives Strategic Investment from Arm, Further Extending Long-Term Partnership
summary: Arm Holdings plc has made a strategic minority investment in Raspberry Pi Ltd, deepening their partnership that began in 2008. This investment aims to further enable the Internet of Things (IoT) developer community with low-cost, high-performance computing solutions built on Arm technology, particularly as edge compute and AI applications grow. Both companies share a vision to democratize technology and remove barriers to entry for innovation across various user groups.

title: Jabil takes on Intel's silicon photonics transceiver module business
summary: Jabil has acquired Intel's silicon photonics pluggable transceiver module business, integrating it into Jabil Photonics to expand its presence in the data center supply chain. This move allows Intel to focus on higher-value silicon photonics components for AI infrastructure, as part of its broader cost-cutting and portfolio optimization strategy. The acquisition aims to better position Jabil to address evolving data center demands, particularly those driven by artificial intelligence.

title: Fortinet (FTNT) Q3 Earnings Beat Expectations, Sales Miss
summary: Fortinet (FTNT) reported mixed third-quarter 2023 results, with non-GAAP earnings per share of 41 cents surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 37 cents, an improvement of 41.4% year-over-year. However, total revenues of $1.33 billion missed the consensus mark by 1% despite a 16.1% year-over-year increase, driven by strong demand from small enterprise customers. The company provided guidance for Q4 and the full year 2023, while several analyst recommendations were mentioned.

title: Intel CEO Admits to and Details The Company's Three Biggest Mistakes
summary: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger openly discussed what he considers Intel's three biggest missteps: the failed smartphone business, the cancellation of the early AI-oriented GPU Larrabee, and the historical lack of focus on building a robust foundry. He believes these errors led to a disadvantage in the current AI market and impacted the company's overall direction. Gelsinger is now driving Intel's IDM 2.0 initiative, opening its fabs to external customers to generate revenue and invest in manufacturing and R&D.

title: Investing in Semiconductor ETFs & Stocks
summary: This article explores investing in semiconductor ETFs and stocks, detailing the sector's evolution, market dynamics, and future outlook, especially concerning AI. It highlights semiconductors' crucial role in modern technology, the economic powerhouse of the industry, and the benefits of investing via ETFs for diversification and accessibility. The piece also discusses factors influencing the sector, including geopolitical efforts to secure supply chains and the profound impact of AI on semiconductor demand and innovation.

title: Invest in the Market’s Momentum – and NVIDIA’s – With SPMO
summary: The article discusses the market's recent strong momentum, highlighted by the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite's best week since November 2022, and NVIDIA's significant gains. It suggests the Invesco S&P 500 Momentum ETF (SPMO) as a way for investors to capitalize on this momentum, noting that NVIDIA is currently SPMO's top holding.

title: Penguin Solutions to Showcase Expertise in AI and HPC at SC23
summary: Penguin Solutions will exhibit its AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) solutions at Supercomputing 2023 (SC23) in Denver from November 12-17. The company's booth will feature technology demonstrations on designing, building, deploying, and managing AI/HPC infrastructures, including insights into immersion cooling and hybrid cloud solutions. Penguin experts will also participate in speaking engagements discussing AI factories and sustainable deployment environments like immersion cooling.

title: Cisco taps ex-Microsoft executive Rodney Clark to lead partner network
summary: Cisco Systems Inc. has appointed Rodney Clark, a former Microsoft executive, as its new senior vice president for Partnerships and Small & Medium Business. Clark will be responsible for leading Cisco's global partner network. His appointment was announced on November 6, 2023.

title: Amdocs and NVIDIA to Accelerate Adoption of Generative AI for $1.7 Trillion Telecom Industry
summary: Amdocs and NVIDIA announced a collaboration to optimize large language models (LLMs) to accelerate the adoption of generative AI applications and services across the $1.7 trillion telecommunications and media industries. This partnership will see Amdocs customize enterprise-grade LLMs on NVIDIA accelerated computing, leveraging NVIDIA DGX Cloud AI supercomputing and NVIDIA AI Enterprise software within the Amdocs amAIz framework. The initiative aims to enable communications service providers to efficiently deploy generative AI for customer experiences, network provisioning, and other operational enhancements, building on Amdocs' existing partnership with Microsoft.

title: The Evolution Of AI: From IBM And AWS To OpenAI and Anthropic
summary: This article traces the extensive history of Artificial Intelligence, starting from its foundational concepts in the 1950s, through periods of significant advancement and slowdowns like the "AI Winter." It highlights the pivotal contributions of major tech companies such as IBM with Watson, Amazon and Apple with virtual assistants, Google with deep learning breakthroughs, and OpenAI and Anthropic with generative AI and safety-focused development. The piece also discusses the critical role of hardware companies like Intel and NVIDIA, and looks ahead to future directions including responsible AI, spatial AI, and customer-centric applications.

title: After Earnings, Is AMD Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar assesses AMD's stock post-Q3 earnings, evaluating its fair value, economic moat, and future prospects, particularly in the AI accelerator market. The company's target of over $2 billion in AI accelerator revenue for 2024 positions it as a significant player. title: Apple's stock underperformed top tech peers in 2023 due to longest revenue slide in 22 years
summary: Apple's stock underperformed its mega-cap tech peers in 2023, experiencing its longest revenue slide in 22 years with four consecutive quarters of declining sales. This decline was attributed to a combination of a weak economic environment for smartphones and PCs, and company-specific issues such as the lack of new iPad models and an Apple Watch sales ban. Despite a 49% stock rally for the year, Apple lagged behind competitors like Nvidia, Meta, Tesla, Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft.

title: Cyber Hornet S&P 500 and Bitcoin 75/25 Strategy ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NASDAQ:ZZZ)
summary: The Cyber Hornet S&P 500 and Bitcoin 75/25 Strategy ETF (ZZZ) is an exchange-traded fund launched on December 28, 2023, by Onefund, which invests in a 75/25 blend of US large-cap stocks and front-month CME Bitcoin futures. It does not directly invest in Bitcoin's spot price. The ETF has an aggregate rating of "Moderate Buy," assets under management of $6.02 million, and a net expense ratio of 1.01%.

title: Cathie Wood says ARK dumped Nvidia shares before 160% surge because it’s ‘just pivoting’ to other A.I. plays
summary: Cathie Wood defended Ark Invest's decision to sell Nvidia shares before a significant surge, citing concerns about the chip industry's cyclical nature and increasing competition. While Ark's flagship ETF missed most of the rally, Wood stated they are pivoting to other AI plays that are currently undervalued. She highlighted companies like Meta Platforms Inc. for their AI focus, despite not being in Ark's main portfolio.

title: Top-Performing Stocks of 2023
summary: The article details the top-performing stocks of 2023, highlighting Coinbase, Nvidia, DraftKings, Meta Platforms, and Palantir Technologies among others. It also identifies undervalued top performers and top-performing moat stocks and technology stocks, providing Morningstar analyst insights and key metrics for each.

title: Netherlands Blocks ASML Exports of Some Chip-Making Equipment to China
summary: The Netherlands has partially blocked ASML's exports of certain lithography systems to China, affecting the shipment of NXT:2050i and NXT:2100i systems in 2023. This decision follows U.S. export restrictions and impacts China's ability to produce advanced microprocessors. ASML, a crucial chip-equipment manufacturer, confirmed the Dutch government's partial revocation of the export license.

title: The U.S.-China Chip War: Who Dares to Win?
summary: The U.S. and China are engaged in a semiconductor industry rivalry, with the U.S. aiming to boost domestic chip production through the CHIPS and Science Act while imposing sanctions on China to hinder its self-reliance in the sector. However, the CHIPS Act faces challenges like high production costs and specific conditions that may deter leading companies. Other nations like the EU and Japan are also implementing strategies to increase their semiconductor manufacturing capabilities amid global supply chain concerns.

title: The best and worst performing funds and sectors of 2023
summary: The article reviews the top and bottom performing funds and sectors in 2023, highlighting crypto, semiconductor, and AI-related funds as top performers. It also notes the strong performance of the Emerging Europe and Technology equity sectors, while Chinese and Hong Kong stocks were among the worst performers. Two property funds linked to the Chinese market were the poorest performing, with one facing termination.

title: Netherlands blocks some ASML exports to China
summary: The Dutch government has partially revoked an export license for certain ASML chipmaking equipment to China, impacting a small number of Chinese customers. This decision follows US export restrictions and affects advanced lithography systems. Despite China being a major market for ASML, the company does not expect a material impact on its financial outlook.

title: Cerebras Systems Appoints Shirley Li as General Counsel
summary: Cerebras Systems has announced the appointment of Shirley Li as General Counsel, bringing over a decade of legal and business experience from leading technology companies. Li, who previously served as Chief Legal and People Officer at Snapdocs, Inc. and held legal roles at Cadence Design Systems, Inc., will report directly to CEO Andrew Feldman. Her appointment comes at a time of significant expansion for Cerebras, following major customer partnerships and the development of key AI models in 2023.

title: Markets in Focus: Concentrating on Diversification
summary: The article discusses the increasing concentration in equity markets, exemplified by the "Magnificent Seven" stocks, and the diminished diversification benefits of bonds, especially since 2020. It suggests that investors reassess top-down allocations and broaden equity exposure across diverse regions, sectors, and styles to create more resilient portfolios. The MSCI Adaptive Multi-Factor Allocation Model indicates an overweight to value and low size as of December 31, 2023, with Europe and China trading at lower historical valuations.

title: US plans $162 million award to Microchip Technology to boost production
summary: The U.S. Commerce Department plans to award Microchip Technology $162 million in government grants to increase domestic production of semiconductors and microcontroller units.
